The current month/year has `aria-current="date"`.

## RTL and Dhivehi

Month names come from the locale (މާޗު 2026 in Dhivehi); the chevrons mirror in RTL.

---

<!-- docs/date-and-time/hijri-date.md -->

# HijriDate

Shows a date in the Umm al-Qura Hijri calendar, e.g. "23 Ramadan 1447 AH" (R12.5). Maths come from `@internationalized/date` (`IslamicUmalquraCalendar`); month names are translated, including Dhivehi (ރަމަޟާން).

```tsx
import { HijriDate } from "@javaabu/onu"

<HijriDate date={new Date()} />                       // 23 Ramadan 1447 AH
<HijriDate date={date} format="short" showGregorian /> // 23 Ramadan 1447 (12/03/2026)
<HijriDate date={date} format="numeric" />             // 23/09/1447
```

Helpers: `toHijri(date)` → `{ year, month, day }`, `fromHijri(parts)` → `Date`, `addHijriMonths`, `hijriDaysInMonth`, `hijriMonthName(t, month)`, `formatHijriParts(parts, t, format)` and the `useHijriFormatter()` hook (`(date, format?) => string` in the active locale). To pick a Hijri date, use [HijriDatePicker](./hijri-date-picker.md).

## Props

| Prop              | Type                                             | Default      | Description                |
| ----------------- | ------------------------------------------------ | ------------ | -------------------------- |
| `date`            | `Date`                                           |              | The Gregorian date to show |
| `format`          | `"long" \| "short" \| "month-year" \| "numeric"` | `"long"`     |                            |
| `showGregorian`   | `boolean`                                        | `false`      | Append the Gregorian date  |
| `gregorianFormat` | `string`                                         | `dd/MM/yyyy` | date-fns format            |
| `classNames`      | `{ hijri, gregorian }`                           |              | Classes for each part      |

Other `<time>` props pass through.

## Accessibility

Renders a `<time>` element whose `datetime` is the ISO Gregorian date, so machines and assistive tech get an unambiguous value.

## RTL and Dhivehi

In `dv`: "23 ރަމަޟާން 1447 ހ". Digits stay Western (R12.6).

---

<!-- docs/date-and-time/hijri-date-picker.md -->

# HijriDatePicker

Picks a date on the Umm al-Qura Hijri calendar. The panel shows the Hijri month (each day with its Gregorian day number underneath) and zooms out to Hijri months and years. The value stays a Gregorian `Date`, and the hidden input posts `yyyy-MM-dd`, so it stores like any other date.

```tsx
import { HijriDatePicker, HijriCalendar } from "@javaabu/onu"

<FormField label="Date of the event" name="event_date">
  <HijriDatePicker />
</FormField>

<HijriCalendar selected={date} onSelect={setDate} />
```

The field shows "23 Ramadan 1447 (12/03/2026)" by default.

## Props

### HijriDatePicker

| Prop                                         | Type                                             | Default      | Description                              |
| -------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------ | ------------ | ---------------------------------------- |
| `value` / `defaultValue`                     | `Date \| null`                                   |              | Gregorian date                           |
| `onChange`                                   | `(value: Date \| null) => void`                  |              |                                          |
| `format`                                     | `"long" \| "short" \| "month-year" \| "numeric"` | `"short"`    | Hijri display format                     |
| `showGregorian`                              | `boolean`                                        | `true`       | Also show the Gregorian date             |
| `gregorianFormat`                            | `string`                                         | `dd/MM/yyyy` |                                          |
| `min` / `max`, `weekStartsOn`, `weekendDays` |                                                  |              | As for [DatePicker](./date-picker.md#props) |

Plus the shared picker field props.

### HijriCalendar

`selected`, `onSelect`, `min`, `max`, `weekStartsOn`, `weekendDays`, `showGregorian` (default `true`), `today`, `initialFocus`, `className`, `ref`.

## Accessibility

The days view is an in-house APG grid (react-day-picker has no Hijri support). Day buttons are named with both calendars ("Today, 23 Ramadan 1447 AH, Thursday, March 12th, 2026"); today has `aria-current="date"`; days outside `min`/`max` are `aria-disabled`.

| Key                                       | Action                               |
| ----------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------ |
| <kbd>←</kbd> <kbd>→</kbd>                 | Previous / next day (swapped in RTL) |
| <kbd>↑</kbd> <kbd>↓</kbd>                 | Previous / next week                 |
| <kbd>Page Up</kbd> / <kbd>Page Down</kbd> | Previous / next Hijri month          |
| <kbd>Home</kbd> / <kbd>End</kbd>          | Start / end of the week              |
| <kbd>Enter</kbd> / <kbd>Space</kbd>       | Select                               |
| <kbd>Escape</kbd>                         | Close; focus returns to the field    |

## RTL and Dhivehi

Hijri month names are translated (ރަމަޟާން 1447), weekdays use the Dhivehi date-fns locale, and the grid mirrors in RTL.

---

<!-- docs/date-and-time/multiple-date-picker.md -->

# MultipleDatePicker

Picks any number of days from one calendar. Clicking a day toggles it; the panel stays open until **Done**.

```tsx
import { MultipleDatePicker } from "@javaabu/onu"

;<FormField label="Training days" name="training_days">
  <MultipleDatePicker maxSelected={5} />
</FormField>
```

The value is a sorted `Date[]`. The field lists up to `maxShown` dates ("5 Mar 2026, 20 Mar 2026"), then "3 dates selected". With `name`, one hidden input per date posts `name[]` (`yyyy-MM-dd`). When `maxSelected` is reached, other days are disabled until one is removed.

## Props

| Prop                                                         | Type                      | Default      | Description                              |
| ------------------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------- | ------------ | ---------------------------------------- |
| `value` / `defaultValue`                                     | `Date[]`                  | `[]`         |                                          |
| `onChange`                                                   | `(value: Date[]) => void` |              |                                          |
| `format`                                                     | `string`                  | `d MMM yyyy` | Format of each date in the field         |
| `maxShown`                                                   | `number`                  | `2`          | Dates listed before switching to a count |
| `maxSelected`                                                | `number`                  |              | Most dates that can be picked            |
| `min`, `max`, `disabledDates`, `weekStartsOn`, `weekendDays` |                           |              | As for [DatePicker](./date-picker.md#props) |

Plus the shared picker field props.

## Accessibility

Same calendar and keyboard model as the [DatePicker](./date-picker.md#accessibility); selected days have `aria-selected`. The count ("3 dates selected") is announced politely as it changes.

## RTL and Dhivehi

Translated count ("3 ތާރީޚު ހޮވިފައި"), Dhivehi month and day names, mirrored layout.

---

<!-- docs/date-and-time/week-picker.md -->

# WeekPicker

Picks a whole week: clicking any day selects its week, hovering previews the week, and week numbers are shown. Built in-house on the shadcn calendar (no library offers a week picker).

```tsx
import { WeekPicker } from "@javaabu/onu"

;<FormField label="Roster week" name="roster_week">
  <WeekPicker />
</FormField>
```

The value is the first day of the week (`Date`), following the locale's week start or `weekStartsOn`. The field shows "Week 12, 2026 (15 Mar – 21 Mar)"; the hidden input posts the first day (`yyyy-MM-dd`).

## Props

| Prop                        | Type                                 | Default | Description                              |
| --------------------------- | ------------------------------------ | ------- | ---------------------------------------- |
| `value` / `defaultValue`    | `Date \| null`                       |         | First day of the week                    |
| `onChange`                  | `(value: Date \| null) => void`      |         |                                          |
| `weekStartsOn`              | `0–6`                                | locale  |                                          |
| `formatWeek`                | `(start: Date, end: Date) => string` |         | Custom field text                        |
| `min`, `max`, `weekendDays` |                                      |         | As for [DatePicker](./date-picker.md#props) |

Plus the shared picker field props.

## Accessibility

Days keep the [DatePicker keyboard model](./date-picker.md#accessibility); <kbd>Enter</kbd> on any day picks its week. All seven days of the selected week have `aria-selected`; week numbers are row headers.

## RTL and Dhivehi

"2026 ގެ 11 ވަނަ ހަފްތާ" in Dhivehi; the week row mirrors in RTL.

---

<!-- docs/date-and-time/reporting-period-picker.md -->

# ReportingPeriodPicker

Picks a **monthly**, **quarterly**, **yearly** or **custom** reporting period, with a configurable financial-year start. Built in-house from the calendar, period grids and shadcn's `ToggleGroup`.

```tsx
import { ReportingPeriodPicker, type ReportingPeriod } from "@javaabu/onu"

const [period, setPeriod] = React.useState<ReportingPeriod | null>(null)
<FormField label="Period" name="period">
  <ReportingPeriodPicker value={period} onChange={setPeriod} fiscalYearStartMonth={6} />
</FormField>
```

The value is `{ type, from, to }` where `from` is the first day and `to` the end of the last day. Hidden inputs post `name[type]`, `name[from]` and `name[to]` (`yyyy-MM-dd`).

- **Monthly**: a 12-month grid (zooms out to years).
- **Quarterly**: Q1–Q4 of the financial year, each showing its months (e.g. "Q1 Jul – Sep" when the year starts in July).
- **Yearly**: 12 financial years ("2025/26"); plain years when the year starts in January.
- **Custom**: a range calendar; closing with only a start picked keeps a one-day range.

`fiscalYear(startMonth)` is exported for the same maths elsewhere (`yearOf`, `label`, `quarter`, `quarterOf`, `range`).

## Props

| Prop                     | Type                                       | Default       | Description                       |
| ------------------------ | ------------------------------------------ | ------------- | --------------------------------- |
| `value` / `defaultValue` | `ReportingPeriod \| null`                  |               |                                   |
| `onChange`               | `(value: ReportingPeriod \| null) => void` |               |                                   |
| `types`                  | `ReportingPeriodType[]`                    | all four      | Kinds offered, in order           |
| `defaultType`            | `ReportingPeriodType`                      | first type    | Kind shown first when empty       |
| `fiscalYearStartMonth`   | `0–11`                                     | `0` (January) | First month of the financial year |
| `format`                 | `string`                                   | `dd/MM/yyyy`  | Format of custom ranges           |
| `min` / `max`            | `Date`                                     |               | Periods outside are greyed out    |

Plus the shared picker field props; see [DatePicker](./date-picker.md#props).

## Accessibility

The kind switch is a labelled radio group (Radix `ToggleGroup`, arrow keys). Quarters and years are APG grids: arrows move, <kbd>Page Up</kbd>/<kbd>Page Down</kbd> change the year (12 years in the yearly view), <kbd>Enter</kbd> picks; the current period has `aria-current="date"`. The custom range uses the [DatePicker keyboard model](./date-picker.md#accessibility).

## RTL and Dhivehi

All labels are translated ("2025/26 ގެ 3 ވަނަ ކުއާޓަރ"); grids and arrows mirror in RTL.

---

<!-- docs/date-and-time/date-calendar.md -->

# DateCalendar

The calendar inside every Onu date picker, for use inline. The days view is shadcn's `Calendar` (react-day-picker); clicking the header zooms out to **months**, **years** (12) and **ranges of years** (12 blocks of 12), which are accessible grids with the same keyboard model (REQUIREMENTS §25.1).

```tsx
import { DateCalendar } from "@javaabu/onu"

<DateCalendar selected={date} onSelect={setDate} />
<DateCalendar mode="multiple" selected={dates} onSelect={setDates} maxSelected={3} />
<DateCalendar mode="range" selected={range} onSelect={setRange} />
<DateCalendar minView="month" onPeriodSelect={setMonth} />   // a month grid
```

`mode="none"` turns off built-in selection so you can use `onDayClick` and `modifiers` (the week picker does this). It is not exported as `Calendar`, so shadcn's `Calendar` primitive stays available unchanged.

## Props

| Prop                                                               | Type                                          | Default           | Description                                           |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------ | --------------------------------------------- | ----------------- | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| `mode`                                                             | `"single" \| "multiple" \| "range" \| "none"` | `"single"`        |                                                       |
| `selected` / `onSelect`                                            | `Date \| null`, `Date[]`, or `{ from, to }`   |                   | Per mode                                              |
| `maxSelected`                                                      | `number`                                      |                   | `multiple` only; other days are disabled at the limit |
| `min` / `max` / `disabledDates`                                    | `Date`, `Matcher \| Matcher[]`                |                   | Disabled days, months and years                       |
| `month` / `defaultMonth` / `onMonthChange`                         | `Date`                                        | selected or today | Displayed month                                       |
| `view` / `defaultView` / `onViewChange`                            | `"day" \| "month" \| "year" \| "decade"`      | `minView`         | Zoom level                                            |
| `minView`                                                          | `"day" \| "month" \| "year"`                  | `"day"`           | Lowest zoom level                                     |
| `onPeriodSelect`                                                   | `(date: Date) => void`                        |                   | Called when a cell is picked at `minView`             |
| `weekStartsOn`, `weekendDays`, `showOutsideDays`, `showWeekNumber` |                                               |                   |                                                       |
| `modifiers`, `modifiersClassNames`, `onDayClick`                   |                                               |                   | Passed to react-day-picker                            |
| `today`                                                            | `Date`                                        | now               | Pins "today"                                          |
| `initialFocus`                                                     | `boolean`                                     |                   | Focus the active day when mounted                     |
| `className`                                                        | `string`                                      |                   | Root classes                                          |
| `classNames`                                                       | `{ header, caption, nav, grid, cell }`        |                   | Classes for each part                                 |
| `ref`                                                              | `Ref<HTMLDivElement>`                         |                   |                                                       |

`DEFAULT_WEEKEND_DAYS` (`[5, 6]`, Friday and Saturday) is exported.

## Accessibility

See the [DatePicker keyboard table](./date-picker.md#accessibility). The caption is a button ("March 2026: choose a month"); page changes are announced through a polite live region; the current month/year/range has `aria-current="date"`.

## RTL and Dhivehi

Arrow keys follow visual order in RTL; chevrons mirror; month and weekday names come from the locale.

---

<!-- docs/date-and-time/time-panel.md -->

# TimePanel

The steppers, clock-face hour grid and minute grid used inside [TimePicker](./time-picker.md) and [DateTimePicker](./date-time-picker.md), for use inline (e.g. in a card or a custom popover).

```tsx
import { TimePanel, type TimeValue } from "@javaabu/onu"

const [time, setTime] = React.useState<TimeValue | null>({ hours: 9, minutes: 30 })
<TimePanel value={time} onChange={setTime} />
```

## Props

| Prop                                    | Type                                 | Default      | Description                 |
| --------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------ | ------------ | --------------------------- |
| `value`                                 | `{ hours, minutes } \| null`         |              | `null` shows "--"           |
| `onChange`                              | `(value: TimeValue) => void`         |              |                             |
| `hourCycle`                             | `12 \| 24`                           | locale       |                             |
| `minuteStep`                            | `number`                             | `5`          | Minute grid step            |
| `view` / `defaultView` / `onViewChange` | `"steppers" \| "hours" \| "minutes"` | `"steppers"` | Which part is shown         |
| `initialFocus`                          | `boolean`                            |              | Focus the hour when mounted |
| `className`                             | `string`                             |              | Root classes                |
| `classNames`                            | `{ stepper, number, period, grid }`  |              | Classes for each part       |
| `ref`                                   | `Ref<HTMLDivElement>`                |              | Root element                |

## Accessibility

Same model as the [TimePicker](./time-picker.md#accessibility): spinbuttons for hour and minute, a labelled AM/PM group, and APG grids with roving focus. <kbd>A</kbd>/<kbd>P</kbd> switch AM/PM anywhere in the panel.

## RTL and Dhivehi

All labels are translated; the clock face keeps its orientation in RTL.

---

<!-- docs/date-and-time/full-calendar.md -->

# FullCalendar

A full calendar with **month**, **week**, **day** and **agenda** views, built on [FullCalendar](https://fullcalendar.io) v6 using only its MIT "standard" plugins (`daygrid`, `timegrid`, `list`, `interaction`; R4.3). It has Onu's own responsive toolbar, a theme made from Onu tokens (light and dark), RTL and a Dhivehi locale. It lives in a separate entry so the main bundle stays small.

```bash
pnpm add @fullcalendar/core @fullcalendar/react @fullcalendar/daygrid @fullcalendar/timegrid @fullcalendar/list @fullcalendar/interaction
```

```tsx
import { FullCalendar, type CalendarEvent } from "@javaabu/onu/calendar"

const events: CalendarEvent[] = [
  { id: "1", title: "Council meeting", start: new Date(2026, 2, 12, 10), end: new Date(2026, 2, 12, 11) },
  { id: "2", title: "Independence Day", start: "2026-07-26", allDay: true, color: "success" },
]

;<FullCalendar
  events={events}
  editable
  selectable
  onDateClick={({ date }) => openCreateDialog(date)}
  onSelect={({ start, end }) => openCreateDialog(start, end)}
  onEventClick={({ event }) => openEvent(event.id)}
  onEventDrop={(arg) => save(arg.event).catch(() => arg.revert())}
  onEventResize={(arg) => save(arg.event).catch(() => arg.revert())}
/>
```

- `color` takes a theme colour (`primary`, `success`, `warning`, `destructive`, `info`, `secondary`, `chart-1`…`chart-8`), so events follow dark mode and `--onu-primary`. Any other FullCalendar event field (`backgroundColor`, `extendedProps`, `url`, …) passes through.
- The toolbar (‹ Today › · title · view switch) wraps on narrow containers; on phones the calendar opens on the agenda. No view scrolls the page sideways at 375px, in LTR or RTL: the agenda's screen-reader header is hidden in place (FullCalendar's `left: -10000px` would otherwise add 10,000px of overflow in RTL) and month events clip inside their day cell.
- Weekend days (Friday and Saturday by default) are shaded; today is marked.
- `apiRef` gives FullCalendar's `CalendarApi`; `options` passes any other FullCalendar option (Onu's props win); `hideToolbar` lets you build your own.

## Locales

`fullCalendarLocale(onuLocale, { weekStartsOn, hourCycle })` builds a FullCalendar locale from an Onu locale (texts, direction, week start, and date formats through date-fns, since browsers have no Dhivehi date data). `dvFullCalendarLocale` is the ready-made Dhivehi one. `FullCalendar` applies the active locale automatically.

## Props

| Prop                                       | Type                                     | Default                      | Description                              |
| ------------------------------------------ | ---------------------------------------- | ---------------------------- | ---------------------------------------- |
| `events`                                   | `CalendarEvent[]`                        |                              |                                          |
| `view` / `defaultView` / `onViewChange`    | `"month" \| "week" \| "day" \| "agenda"` | `month` (`agenda` on phones) |                                          |
| `views`                                    | `FullCalendarView[]`                     | all four                     | Views in the switcher                    |
| `initialDate`                              | `Date`                                   | today                        |                                          |
| `onRangeChange`                            | `({ start, end, view }) => void`         |                              | Visible range changed (load events here) |
| `editable` / `selectable`                  | `boolean`                                | `false`                      | Drag/resize events; select ranges        |
| `onDateClick`                              | `({ date, allDay }) => void`             |                              |                                          |
| `onSelect`                                 | `({ start, end, allDay }) => void`       |                              |                                          |
| `onEventClick`                             | `(arg: EventClickArg) => void`           |                              | Also makes events keyboard-focusable     |
| `onEventDrop` / `onEventResize`            | `(arg) => void`                          |                              | Call `arg.revert()` to undo              |
| `weekStartsOn`, `weekendDays`, `hourCycle` |                                          | locale / `[5, 6]`            |                                          |
| `height`                                   | `"auto" \| string \| number`             | `"auto"`                     |                                          |
| `hideToolbar`                              | `boolean`                                | `false`                      |                                          |
| `options`                                  | `CalendarOptions`                        |                              | Any other FullCalendar option            |
| `apiRef`                                   | `Ref<CalendarApi \| null>`               |                              |                                          |
| `className` / `classNames`                 | `{ toolbar, title, calendar }`           |                              |                                          |

## Accessibility

- The toolbar buttons are labelled ("Previous", "Today", "Next"); the view switch is a labelled radio group; the title is a heading announced politely when the range changes.
- With `onEventClick`, events are focusable and open with <kbd>Enter</kbd>. Day numbers are links to the day view.
- Drag and resize are pointer gestures; offer an edit form as the keyboard alternative (R3.27). Creating by clicking a day also needs a button alternative in your page (e.g. "New event").

## RTL and Dhivehi

With `locale="dv"` the calendar runs right to left with Dhivehi buttons, month and weekday names, and މކ/މފ times.

---

<!-- docs/choice-inputs/select.md -->

# Select

A select for short lists, built on shadcn's select (Radix). Pass an `options` array, or `SelectItem` children. Optional fields can show a clear button.

```tsx
import { Select, SelectGroup, SelectItem, SelectLabel } from '@javaabu/onu';

<Select options={[{ value: 'K', label: 'Kaafu' }, { value: 'S', label: 'Seenu' }]} placeholder="Select an atoll" />

<Select options={['Female', 'Male']} value={gender} onValueChange={setGender} clearable />

<Select placeholder="Choose an office">
  <SelectGroup>
    <SelectLabel>Malé</SelectLabel>
    <SelectItem value="hq">Head office</SelectItem>
  </SelectGroup>
</Select>
```

Options with the same `group` are listed under that heading. Options may be plain strings (value = label).

## Props

| Prop                                    | Type                                      | Default            | Description                                                   |
| --------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------- | ------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `options`                               | `(ChoiceOption \| string)[]`              |                    | Options; or pass `SelectItem` / `SelectGroup` children        |
| `value` / `defaultValue`                | `string`                                  | `""`               | Selected value; `""` shows the placeholder                    |
| `onValueChange`                         | `(value: string) => void`                 |                    | Also called with `""` when cleared                            |
| `placeholder`                           | `string`                                  | "Select an option" | Text when empty                                               |
| `clearable`                             | `boolean`                                 | `false`            | Show a clear button when a value is set; hidden when required |
| `size`                                  | `"sm" \| "default" \| "lg"`               | `"default"`        | Trigger height                                                |
| `position`                              | `"item-aligned" \| "popper"`              | `"item-aligned"`   | Open over the trigger or below it                             |
| `name`, `required`, `disabled`, `form`  |                                           |                    | Form props (a native select is rendered inside a `<form>`)    |
| `open` / `defaultOpen` / `onOpenChange` |                                           |                    | Controlled open state                                         |
| `className`                             | `string`                                  |                    | Classes for the trigger                                       |
| `classNames`                            | `{ root, trigger, content, item, clear }` |                    | Classes for each part                                         |

Other button props (`aria-label`, `id`, …) and `ref` go to the trigger button.

:::info

`Select` replaces shadcn's `Select` root in the main export. It stays compatible: if its children contain `SelectTrigger` and `SelectContent`, it behaves exactly like the shadcn root. The primitive is still available from `@javaabu/onu/primitives`. Differences: it always manages the value (so it can be cleared), and an empty value is `""`.

:::

## Accessibility

Radix select: the trigger is a `combobox` with a listbox popup. Wrap it in a [`FormField`](../form-scaffolding/form-field.md) or give it `aria-label`.

| Key                | Action                                         |
| ------------------ | ---------------------------------------------- |
| Enter, Space, ↓, ↑ | Open the list                                  |
| ↓ / ↑, Home / End  | Move through options                           |
| Typing             | Jump to the option starting with those letters |
| Enter              | Choose the highlighted option                  |
| Escape             | Close and return focus to the trigger          |

## RTL and touch

The chevron, clear button and list mirror in RTL. On coarse pointers the trigger and items are at least 44px tall. Use [Searchable select](./searchable-select.md) for long lists (it opens as a bottom sheet on phones).

---

<!-- docs/choice-inputs/searchable-select.md -->

# Searchable select

A select with a search field: a field that opens a searchable list (shadcn Popover + Command; a bottom sheet on phones). Matching uses `Intl.Collator`, so "male" finds "Malé", and Thaana vowel signs are respected. The search field accepts [`thaana`](../guides/thaana-input.md).

```tsx
import { SearchableSelect } from '@javaabu/onu';

<SearchableSelect options={islands} placeholder="Select an island" clearable />
<SearchableSelect options={dhivehiIslands} thaana />
<SearchableSelect options={islands} multiple defaultValue={['male']} />
```

## Options

```ts
interface ChoiceOption {
  value: string
  label: string // shown and searched
  description?: ReactNode // second line
  icon?: ReactNode
  disabled?: boolean
  group?: string // heading
  keywords?: string[] // extra search terms
}
```

## Props

| Prop                                    | Type                                                                                      | Default            | Description                                               |
| --------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------- |
| `options`                               | `(ChoiceOption \| string)[]`                                                              |                    | Options                                                   |
| `multiple`                              | `boolean`                                                                                 | `false`            | Several values (see [Multi-select](./multi-select.md))       |
| `value` / `defaultValue`                | `string \| null` (`string[]` when multiple)                                               |                    | Selected value(s)                                         |
| `onValueChange`                         | `(value, option) => void`                                                                 |                    | Called with the value(s) and option(s)                    |
| `placeholder` / `searchPlaceholder`     | `string`                                                                                  | from locale        |                                                           |
| `thaana`                                | `boolean \| ThaanaOptions`                                                                |                    | Thaana keyboard in the search field                       |
| `clearable`                             | `boolean`                                                                                 | `false`            | Clear button; hidden on required fields                   |
| `filter`                                | `(option, query) => boolean`                                                              |                    | Replace the collator matching                             |
| `emptyText`                             | `string`                                                                                  | "No results for …" |                                                           |
| `renderOption` / `renderValue`          | functions                                                                                 |                    | Custom rendering                                          |
| `size`                                  | `"sm" \| "default" \| "lg"`                                                               | `"default"`        |                                                           |
| `sheet`                                 | `boolean`                                                                                 | `true`             | Bottom sheet on phones                                    |
| `name`, `required`, `disabled`          |                                                                                           |                    | `name` renders hidden input(s); multiple submits `name[]` |
| `open` / `defaultOpen` / `onOpenChange` |                                                                                           |                    | Controlled open state                                     |
| `classNames`                            | `{ root, trigger, value, placeholder, chip, clear, content, search, list, item, status }` |                    |                                                           |

Other button props and `ref` go to the trigger. `choiceFieldVariants` (the field box) is exported. The `matchesQuery` and `filterOptions` helpers are exported too.

## Accessibility

The trigger is a `combobox` button; the popup holds a search `combobox` and a `listbox` (cmdk). The number of results, "No results" and loading/error states are announced in a polite live region.

| Key                 | Action                                                     |
| ------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- |
| ↓ / ↑ on the field  | Open                                                       |
| Typing on the field | Open and start searching with that character               |
| ↓ / ↑, Home / End   | Move through options (wraps)                               |
| Enter               | Choose; single selects close and return focus to the field |
| Escape              | Close and return focus to the field                        |
| Backspace / Delete  | On a clearable field: clear the value                      |

## RTL and touch

Everything mirrors in RTL. On phones the list opens as a bottom sheet with 44px rows (R3.28).

---

<!-- docs/choice-inputs/dependent-select.md -->

# Dependent select

A select whose options depend on another field (atoll → island). It is disabled until the parent has a value and **clears itself whenever the parent changes**. Options come from a map, a function, `loadOptions` or an API `url` (the same data layer as [API select](./api-select.md)).

```tsx
import { DependentSelect, Select } from '@javaabu/onu';

<Select options={atolls} value={atoll} onValueChange={setAtoll} />

// Static map
<DependentSelect parentValue={atoll} parentLabel="an atoll" options={{ K: kaafuIslands, S: seenuIslands }} />

// Loaded and cached per parent
<DependentSelect parentValue={atoll} loadOptions={(atoll, { query, signal }) => api.islands(atoll, query, signal)} />

// From an API: GET /api/islands?atoll_id=K&search=…
<DependentSelect parentValue={atoll} url="/api/islands" parentParam="atoll_id" />
```

## Props

All [Searchable select](./searchable-select.md) and [API select](./api-select.md) props, plus:

| Prop          | Type                                                           | Default       | Description                                         |
| ------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------- | --------------------------------------------------- |
| `parentValue` | `string \| number \| null`                                     |               | The value this field depends on                     |
| `parentLabel` | `string`                                                       |               | Shown as "Select {parentLabel} first" while waiting |
| `options`     | `Record<string, ChoiceOption[]> \| (parent) => ChoiceOption[]` |               | Local options per parent                            |
| `loadOptions` | `(parent, { query, page, signal }) => Promise<response>`       |               | Async options (cached per parent and search)        |
| `url`         | `string`                                                       |               | API endpoint                                        |
| `parentParam` | `string`                                                       | `"parent_id"` | Request param carrying the parent value             |

When the parent changes, `onValueChange(null)` (or `[]` for multiple) is called.

## Accessibility

Same as Searchable select. While disabled the placeholder explains which field to fill first.

---

<!-- docs/choice-inputs/api-select.md -->

# API select

A searchable select that loads its options from **any API** (REQUIREMENTS R16.5). Laravel resources and paginators work with no configuration. Results are cached with TanStack Query; no `QueryClientProvider` is needed (Onu falls back to its own client, and uses yours when there is one).

```tsx
import { ApiSelect } from '@javaabu/onu';

// GET /api/islands?search=mal&page=1  →  { data: [{ id, name }], meta: { current_page, last_page } }
<ApiSelect url="/api/islands" />

// Edit page: show the current value's label without opening the list
<ApiSelect url="/api/islands" defaultValue="12" valueUrl="/api/islands/{value}" />
<ApiSelect url="/api/islands" defaultValue="12" initialOptions={[{ value: '12', label: 'Malé' }]} />

// Any response shape
<ApiSelect url="https://api.example.mv/atolls" itemsPath="results.items" valueKey="code" labelKey="title.en" />
<ApiSelect url="/api/people" mapOption={(p) => ({ value: p.uuid, label: `${p.first} ${p.last}` })} />

// Your own loader
<ApiSelect fetcher={(query, { page, signal }) => client.get('/people', { query, page, signal })} cacheKey="people" />

// Dependent params: refetches and clears when the atoll changes
<ApiSelect url="/api/islands" params={{ atoll_id: atoll }} dependsOn={atoll} />
```

## How it behaves

- **Searching** is debounced (300ms) and can require `minChars`. Each search is its own request; when the user keeps typing, older requests are cancelled with `AbortController`, and because every search has its own cache entry a slow early response can never replace newer results.
- **Paging**: when the response says there is a next page (`meta.last_page`, `last_page`, `next_page_url`, `links.next`, `next_cursor`), the next page loads as the list scrolls to the end.
- **Preloading**: options load when the list opens, or immediately with `preload`.
- **States**: loading, empty ("No results for …"), and an error with a **Retry** button. All are announced in a polite live region.
- **Caching**: per endpoint + params + query, for `staleTime` (5 minutes). After creating a record elsewhere, call `invalidateApiOptions(url)` (or `queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: apiOptionsQueryKey(url) })` with your own client). Quick-create (`onCreate`) invalidates automatically.
- **No requests without a URL or fetcher** you supply; CSRF and auth headers are yours to add (`headers`, `credentials`).

## Props

All [Searchable select](./searchable-select.md) props (including `multiple`, `thaana`, `clearable`, `selectAll`, `max`) and [quick-create](./quick-create-select.md) props, plus:

| Prop                                         | Type                                                    | Default                                  | Description                                                 |
| -------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------- |
| `url`                                        | `string`                                                |                                          | Endpoint (same- or cross-origin)                            |
| `fetcher`                                    | `(query, { page, signal, params }) => Promise<unknown>` |                                          | Custom loader; its response is mapped like a `url` response |
| `method`                                     | `"GET" \| "POST"`                                       | `"GET"`                                  | POST sends params as JSON                                   |
| `headers`, `credentials`                     | `HeadersInit`, `RequestCredentials`                     |                                          | Request options                                             |
| `params`                                     | `object \| (query) => object`                           |                                          | Extra params; arrays become `key[]`                         |
| `searchParam` / `pageParam` / `perPageParam` | `string`                                                | `search` / `page` / `per_page`           | Param names                                                 |
| `perPage`                                    | `number`                                                |                                          | Page size to request                                        |
| `itemsPath`                                  | `string`                                                | auto (`data`, `items`, `results`, array) | Dot path to the items                                       |
| `valueKey` / `labelKey` / `descriptionKey`   | `string`                                                | `id` / `name` (with fallbacks)           | Item keys (dot paths work)                                  |
| `mapOption`                                  | `(item) => ChoiceOption`                                |                                          | Full control over mapping                                   |
| `debounce`                                   | `number`                                                | `300`                                    | ms                                                          |
| `minChars`                                   | `number`                                                | `0`                                      | Minimum search length                                       |
| `preload`                                    | `boolean`                                               | `false`                                  | Load before opening                                         |
| `initialOptions`                             | `ChoiceOption[]`                                        |                                          | Known options (e.g. the current value)                      |
| `valueUrl`                                   | `string \| (value) => string`                           |                                          | Loads one item to label a value; `{value}` is replaced      |
| `fetchById`                                  | `(value, { signal }) => Promise<unknown>`               |                                          | Alternative to `valueUrl`                                   |
| `staleTime` / `gcTime`                       | `number`                                                | 5 / 10 minutes                           | Cache lifetime                                              |
| `cacheKey`                                   | `string`                                                | `url`                                    | Cache key for `fetcher`s                                    |
| `dependsOn`                                  | `unknown`                                               |                                          | When it changes the value clears                            |
| `queryClient`                                | `QueryClient`                                           | app or Onu client                        |                                                             |

Values are strings (`id: 12` becomes `"12"`), so they round-trip through forms unchanged.

## Data layer

The helpers behind it are exported for Autocomplete and your own components: `fetchApiOptions`, `parseApiResponse`, `parseApiItem`, `mapApiItem`, `detectHasMore`, `buildUrl`, `requestJson`, `useOnuQueryClient`, `getOnuQueryClient`, `invalidateApiOptions`, `apiOptionsQueryKey`.

## Accessibility

As [Searchable select](./searchable-select.md). Loading, result counts, "No results", errors and quick-create results are announced politely; Retry is a real button.

---

<!-- docs/choice-inputs/editable-select.md -->

# Editable select

A text field with a list of suggestions that also accepts anything the user types (a WAI-ARIA combobox with list autocomplete). Typing filters the suggestions with `Intl.Collator`; text that matches none is offered as "Use “…”".

```tsx
import { EditableSelect } from '@javaabu/onu';

<EditableSelect options={['Director', 'Deputy Director']} placeholder="Job title" />
<EditableSelect options={dhivehiTitles} thaana thaanaToggle />
```

## Props

| Prop                                    | Type                                   | Default | Description                                              |
| --------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------- | ------- | -------------------------------------------------------- |
| `options`                               | `(ChoiceOption \| string)[]`           |         | Suggestions                                              |
| `value` / `defaultValue`                | `string`                               | `""`    | The text in the field                                    |
| `onValueChange`                         | `(value, option \| null) => void`      |         | `option` is the picked suggestion, `null` for typed text |
| `thaana` / `thaanaToggle`               | `ThaanaProp` / `boolean`               |         | Thaana keyboard and toggle                               |
| `showCustomOption`                      | `boolean`                              | `true`  | Offer "Use “…”"                                          |
| `open` / `defaultOpen` / `onOpenChange` |                                        |         |                                                          |
| `classNames`                            | `{ root, input, content, list, item }` |         |                                                          |

Other `<input>` props and `ref` go to the input. Picking a suggestion sets the text to its label.

## Accessibility

| Key    | Action                                             |
| ------ | -------------------------------------------------- |
| ↓ / ↑  | Open, then move the highlighted suggestion         |
| Enter  | Use the highlighted suggestion (or the typed text) |
| Escape | Close the list, keeping the text                   |
| Tab    | Close and move on                                  |

Focus stays in the input; the highlighted option is exposed with `aria-activedescendant`.

---

<!-- docs/choice-inputs/multi-select.md -->

# Multi-select

Pick several options. Selected values show as chips in the field (each with a remove button), the list has a "Select all" row for the visible options, and `max` caps the number of values. Same search as [Searchable select](./searchable-select.md).

```tsx
import { MultiSelect } from '@javaabu/onu';

<MultiSelect name="islands" options={islands} defaultValue={['male']} />
<MultiSelect options={ministries} max={3} maxVisibleChips={2} />
```

## Props

All [Searchable select](./searchable-select.md) props with `multiple` fixed on, plus:

| Prop                     | Type                        | Default | Description                                                |
| ------------------------ | --------------------------- | ------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- |
| `value` / `defaultValue` | `string[]`                  |         |                                                            |
| `onValueChange`          | `(values, options) => void` |         |                                                            |
| `selectAll`              | `boolean`                   | `true`  | "Select all" / "Deselect all" row                          |
| `max`                    | `number`                    |         | Maximum values; other options disable, a note explains why |
| `maxVisibleChips`        | `number`                    |         | Collapse the rest into "+N more"                           |
| `clearable`              | `boolean`                   | `true`  | Clear all button                                           |

With `name="islands"` it submits `islands[]` (Laravel arrays).

## Accessibility

Options carry `aria-checked`; the field announces "N selected". Each chip's remove button is labelled "Remove …". In the search field, **Backspace** on an empty search removes the last value. The list stays open while picking.

---

<!-- docs/choice-inputs/dual-listbox.md -->

# Dual listbox

Two lists, "Available" and "Selected", with buttons to move items between them. Useful for permissions and assignments. Each list has its own filter field (with `thaana` support) and stacks vertically in narrow containers (container query).

```tsx
import { DualListbox } from "@javaabu/onu"

;<DualListbox
  options={permissions}
  value={granted}
  onValueChange={setGranted}
  selectedLabel="Granted"
  name="permissions"
/>
```

## Props

| Prop                               | Type                                             | Default                  | Description                 |
| ---------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------ | --------------------------- |
| `options`                          | `(ChoiceOption \| string)[]`                     |                          | All items                   |
| `value` / `defaultValue`           | `string[]`                                       | `[]`                     | Items in the Selected list  |
| `onValueChange`                    | `(values, options) => void`                      |                          |                             |
| `availableLabel` / `selectedLabel` | `string`                                         | "Available" / "Selected" | List headings               |
| `searchable`                       | `boolean`                                        | `true`                   | Filter fields               |
| `thaana`                           | `ThaanaProp`                                     |                          | Thaana in the filter fields |
| `name`                             | `string`                                         |                          | Submits `name[]`            |
| `disabled`                         | `boolean`                                        |                          |                             |
| `classNames`                       | `{ pane, heading, search, list, item, actions }` |                          |                             |

Items keep the order of `options` in both lists. Disabled options cannot move.

## Accessibility

Each list is a multi-select `listbox` (`aria-multiselectable`) with `aria-activedescendant`. Moves are announced ("2 items moved to Selected").

| Key                        | Action                                 |
| -------------------------- | -------------------------------------- |
| ↓ / ↑, Home / End          | Move the highlight                     |
| Space                      | Mark / unmark the highlighted item     |
| Shift + ↓ / ↑, Shift+click | Extend the marked range                |
| Ctrl/⌘ + A                 | Mark everything in the list            |
| Enter, double click        | Move the marked (or highlighted) items |

The move buttons are labelled ("Move selected to Selected", "Move all to Available"); their arrows mirror in RTL and point down/up when stacked.

---

<!-- docs/choice-inputs/checkbox.md -->

# Checkbox

shadcn's checkbox plus a label, description and an indeterminate (mixed) state. Without `label` it renders just the box, exactly like the primitive.

```tsx
import { Checkbox } from '@javaabu/onu';

<Checkbox label="Send me SMS updates" description="We text you when your status changes." />
<Checkbox label="All utilities" checked={all} indeterminate={some} onCheckedChange={toggleAll} />
<Checkbox aria-label="Select row" size="sm" />
```

## Props

All Radix checkbox props (`checked`, `defaultChecked`, `onCheckedChange`, `name`, `value`, `required`, `disabled`), plus:

| Prop            | Type                           | Default     | Description                                    |
| --------------- | ------------------------------ | ----------- | ---------------------------------------------- |
| `label`         | `ReactNode`                    |             | Clickable label beside the box                 |
| `description`   | `ReactNode`                    |             | Secondary text (wired to `aria-describedby`)   |
| `indeterminate` | `boolean`                      |             | Mixed state; same as `checked="indeterminate"` |
| `labelPosition` | `"end" \| "start"`             | `"end"`     | Label after or before the box                  |
| `size`          | `"sm" \| "default" \| "lg"`    | `"default"` | Box size (`checkboxVariants`)                  |
| `className`     | `string`                       |             | Classes for the **box** (as in shadcn)         |
| `classNames`    | `{ root, label, description }` |             | Wrapper, label and description                 |

:::info

`Checkbox` replaces shadcn's primitive in the main export and is API-compatible with it; the primitive is still available from `@javaabu/onu/primitives`.

:::

## Accessibility

A `checkbox` with `aria-checked="mixed"` when indeterminate. Space toggles. The hit area grows to 44px on touch screens. Inside a [`FormField`](../form-scaffolding/form-field.md) it picks up `name`, errors and `required`.

---

<!-- docs/choice-inputs/radio.md -->

# Radio

One radio button with a label, description and, in the card variant, media and an aside. Use it inside a [Radio group](./radio-group.md); it inherits the group's `variant` and `size`.

```tsx
import { Radio, RadioGroup } from '@javaabu/onu';

<RadioGroup aria-label="Collection" defaultValue="post">
  <Radio value="post" label="Post office" description="Within 3 working days" />
  <Radio value="courier" label="Courier" description="Next working day" />
</RadioGroup>

<RadioGroup aria-label="Plan" variant="card">
  <Radio value="team" label="Team" description="50 users" media={<Icon name="users" />} aside="MVR 450" />
</RadioGroup>
```

## Props

All Radix radio item props (`value`, `disabled`, `id`), plus:

| Prop          | Type                                      | Default | Description               |
| ------------- | ----------------------------------------- | ------- | ------------------------- |
| `label`       | `ReactNode`                               |         | Visible label             |
| `description` | `ReactNode`                               |         | Secondary text            |
| `media`       | `ReactNode`                               |         | Card: icon, logo or image |
| `aside`       | `ReactNode`                               |         | Card: content at the end  |
| `variant`     | `"default" \| "card"`                     | group's |                           |
| `size`        | `"default" \| "lg"`                       | group's |                           |
| `classNames`  | `{ root, label, description, indicator }` |         |                           |

`radioCardVariants` is exported for custom cards.

## Accessibility

Each item is a `radio`, named by its label and described by its description. In the card variant the whole card is the control (no nested interactive content).

---

<!-- docs/choice-inputs/radio-group.md -->

# Radio group

A set of radios where one can be chosen (shadcn radio group). Give `options` or [`Radio`](./radio.md) children, in the `default` or `card` variant, stacked or side by side.

```tsx
import { RadioGroup } from '@javaabu/onu';

<RadioGroup options={['Female', 'Male']} orientation="horizontal" />
<RadioGroup
  variant="card"
  options={[
    { value: 'post', label: 'Post', description: 'Collect from the post office' },
    { value: 'courier', label: 'Courier', description: 'To your door', aside: 'MVR 50' },
  ]}
/>
```

## Props

All Radix radio group props (`value`, `defaultValue`, `onValueChange`, `name`, `required`, `disabled`, `loop`), plus:

| Prop          | Type                                      | Default      | Description                                      |
| ------------- | ----------------------------------------- | ------------ | ------------------------------------------------ |
| `options`     | `(RadioGroupOption \| string)[]`          |              | `ChoiceOption` plus `media` and `aside`          |
| `variant`     | `"default" \| "card"`                     | `"default"`  | Radios with labels, or selectable cards          |
| `orientation` | `"vertical" \| "horizontal"`              | `"vertical"` | Horizontal wraps; card columns fit the container |
| `size`        | `"default" \| "lg"`                       | `"default"`  | `lg` for kiosks                                  |
| `classNames`  | `{ item, label, description, indicator }` |              | Applied to every item                            |

:::info

`RadioGroup` replaces shadcn's primitive in the main export and is compatible with it (shadcn `RadioGroupItem` children still work). The primitive is available from `@javaabu/onu/primitives`.

:::

## Accessibility

A `radiogroup`, labelled by its [`FormField`](../form-scaffolding/form-field.md) label (or `aria-label`). Errors set `aria-invalid` on the group and its items.

| Key        | Action                                                |
| ---------- | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| Tab        | Focus the checked radio (or the first)                |
| Arrow keys | Move to and check the next/previous radio; follow RTL |
| Space      | Check the focused radio                               |

---

<!-- docs/choice-inputs/switch.md -->

# Switch

shadcn's switch plus a label and description. Use it for settings that take effect immediately. Without `label` it renders just the switch.

```tsx
import { Switch } from '@javaabu/onu';

<Switch label="Email notifications" description="A daily digest." />
<Switch label="SMS" labelPosition="start" classNames={{ root: 'justify-between w-full' }} />
<Switch aria-label="Dark mode" size="sm" />
```

## Props

All shadcn/Radix switch props (`checked`, `defaultChecked`, `onCheckedChange`, `size`, `name`, `disabled`), plus:

| Prop            | Type                           | Default | Description                               |
| --------------- | ------------------------------ | ------- | ----------------------------------------- |
| `label`         | `ReactNode`                    |         | Clickable label                           |
| `description`   | `ReactNode`                    |         | Secondary text (`aria-describedby`)       |
| `labelPosition` | `"end" \| "start"`             | `"end"` | Settings lists often use `start`          |
| `className`     | `string`                       |         | Classes for the **switch** (as in shadcn) |
| `classNames`    | `{ root, label, description }` |         |                                           |

:::info

`Switch` replaces shadcn's primitive in the main export and is API-compatible; the primitive is available from `@javaabu/onu/primitives`.

:::

## Accessibility

A `switch`; Space and Enter toggle. The thumb moves to the end in both LTR and RTL. The hit area grows to 44px on touch screens.

<!-- docs/choice-inputs/segmented-control.md -->

# Segmented control

Pick one of a few options shown side by side (shadcn toggle group, single mode). One segment is always selected.

```tsx
import { SegmentedControl, Icon } from '@javaabu/onu';

<SegmentedControl options={['Day', 'Week', 'Month']} value={period} onValueChange={setPeriod} />
<SegmentedControl
  aria-label="View"
  iconOnly
  options={[
    { value: 'table', label: 'Table', icon: <Icon name="table" /> },
    { value: 'grid', label: 'Grid', icon: <Icon name="grid" /> },
  ]}
/>
```

## Props

| Prop                     | Type                         | Default      | Description                                     |
| ------------------------ | ---------------------------- | ------------ | ----------------------------------------------- |
| `options`                | `(ChoiceOption \| string)[]` |              | Segments                                        |
| `value` / `defaultValue` | `string`                     | first option |                                                 |
| `onValueChange`          | `(value: string) => void`    |              | Never called with an empty value                |
| `size`                   | `"sm" \| "default" \| "lg"`  | `"default"`  | `segmentedControlVariants`                      |
| `fullWidth`              | `boolean`                    | `false`      | Segments share the container width              |
| `iconOnly`               | `boolean`                    | `false`      | Show only icons; labels stay for screen readers |
| `name`                   | `string`                     |              | Hidden input for forms                          |
| `classNames`             | `{ item }`                   |              |                                                 |

## Layout

Segments size to their label and are never truncated. When there is spare room (for example with `fullWidth`) they share it evenly; when space runs out (a narrow toolbar or phone), the control scrolls sideways instead of cutting labels off. Focusing a segment with the keyboard scrolls it into view.

## Accessibility

A `radiogroup` of `radio` buttons (Radix toggle group, single mode), labelled by its FormField or `aria-label`.

| Key           | Action                                            |
| ------------- | ------------------------------------------------- |
| ← / →         | Move between segments in visual order (RTL aware) |
| Space / Enter | Select the focused segment                        |

---

<!-- docs/choice-inputs/range-slider.md -->

# Range slider

A slider for one value or a range (shadcn slider), with marks, value labels and locale number formatting. It mirrors in RTL.

```tsx
import { RangeSlider } from '@javaabu/onu';

<RangeSlider aria-label="Volume" defaultValue={40} />
<RangeSlider min={0} max={20000} step={500} defaultValue={[1500, 6000]} formatValue={(v) => `MVR ${v}`} showValue="always" />
<RangeSlider min={1} max={10} defaultValue={4} marks={[{ value: 1, label: '1' }, { value: 10, label: '10+' }]} />
```

## Props

All Radix slider props (`min`, `max`, `step`, `minStepsBetweenThumbs`, `orientation`, `disabled`, `name`, `inverted`), plus:

| Prop                              | Type                                                         | Default              | Description                                      |
| --------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ | -------------------- | ------------------------------------------------ |
| `value` / `defaultValue`          | `number \| number[]`                                         | `min`                | A number for one thumb, `[from, to]` for a range |
| `onValueChange` / `onValueCommit` | `(value) => void`                                            |                      | Same shape as the value                          |
| `marks`                           | `(number \| { value, label })[]`                             |                      | Tick marks (horizontal sliders)                  |
| `showValue`                       | `"always" \| "active" \| "never"`                            | `"active"`           | Value bubble above each thumb                    |
| `formatValue`                     | `(value: number) => string`                                  | locale number format | Labels and `aria-valuetext`                      |
| `thumbLabels`                     | `string[]`                                                   | "Minimum", "Maximum" | Thumb names for ranges                           |
| `classNames`                      | `{ root, track, range, thumb, valueLabel, mark, markLabel }` |                      |                                                  |

## Accessibility

Each thumb is a `slider` with `aria-valuetext` from `formatValue`; range thumbs are named "Price, Minimum" / "Price, Maximum".

| Key                 | Action                                   |
| ------------------- | ---------------------------------------- |
| ← / →, ↓ / ↑        | Step (← / → follow the visual direction) |
| Page Up / Page Down | Larger step                              |
| Home / End          | Minimum / maximum                        |

Thumbs grow on touch screens.

---

<!-- docs/choice-inputs/rating.md -->

# Rating

A star rating with optional half steps, a read-only display mode and full keyboard support. Built in-house (no shadcn component exists); stars fill from the reading start, so from the right in RTL.

```tsx
import { Rating } from '@javaabu/onu';

<Rating aria-label="Service" value={value} onValueChange={setValue} allowHalf />
<Rating readOnly value={4.5} size="sm" />
<Rating max={10} icon="heart" name="score" />
```

## Props

| Prop                     | Type                        | Default     | Description                                |
| ------------------------ | --------------------------- | ----------- | ------------------------------------------ |
| `value` / `defaultValue` | `number`                    | `0`         | `0` means not rated                        |
| `onValueChange`          | `(value: number) => void`   |             |                                            |
| `max`                    | `number`                    | `5`         | Number of symbols                          |
| `allowHalf`              | `boolean`                   | `false`     | Half steps (pointer position and keyboard) |
| `readOnly`               | `boolean`                   | `false`     | Display only                               |
| `disabled`               | `boolean`                   |             |                                            |
| `clearable`              | `boolean`                   | `true`      | Clicking the current value clears it       |
| `size`                   | `"sm" \| "default" \| "lg"` | `"default"` | `ratingVariants`                           |
| `icon`                   | semantic icon name          | `"star"`    |                                            |
| `name`                   | `string`                    |             | Hidden input                               |
| `classNames`             | `{ star, filled }`          |             |                                            |

## Accessibility

Interactive ratings are a `slider` with `aria-valuetext` ("3.5 out of 5 stars"); read-only ratings are an `img` with the same text.

| Key        | Action              |
| ---------- | ------------------- |
| → / ↑      | Increase (← in RTL) |
| ← / ↓      | Decrease (→ in RTL) |
| Home / End | 0 / maximum         |
| 0–9        | Set that value      |

<!-- docs/choice-inputs/payment-method-selector.md -->

# Payment method selector

Choose how to pay: **BML Transfer** (bank transfer to a Bank of Maldives account, usually followed by a slip upload) and/or **BML Connect** (BML's online card gateway), as a radio group of large cards with BML's official [logos](./bml-logos.md) (R16.8). It is **selection only**: redirects, callbacks and slip uploads belong to your app.

```tsx
import { PaymentMethodSelector } from '@javaabu/onu';

<PaymentMethodSelector value={method} onValueChange={setMethod} />

<PaymentMethodSelector
  methods={[
    { id: 'bml-connect', label: { en: 'Pay by card', dv: 'ކާޑުން ފައިސާ ދައްކާ' } },
    'bml-transfer',
    { id: 'cash', label: 'Cash', icon: 'banknote' },
  ]}
  defaultValue="bml-connect"
/>
```

:::info Logos

BML Transfer shows the BML logo and BML Connect the BML Connect logo with the Visa, Mastercard and American Express marks: the official assets supplied by BML, as [`BmlTransferLogo` and `BmlConnectLogo`](./bml-logos.md). They sit on a white tile in light and dark mode, and are decorative because each card's label names the method. On phones the BML Connect logo is narrower so the label keeps its room. Project-defined methods (such as cash) show a neutral icon (`icon`) unless you pass a `logo`.

:::

## Props

All [Radio group](./radio-group.md) props except `options`/`variant`, plus:

| Prop                     | Type                                                         | Default | Description                    |
| ------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------ | ------- | ------------------------------ |
| `methods`                | `("bml-transfer" \| "bml-connect" \| PaymentMethodConfig)[]` | both    | Which gateways, in this order  |
| `value` / `defaultValue` | `PaymentMethodId`                                            |         |                                |
| `onValueChange`          | `(id) => void`                                               |         |                                |
| `size`                   | `"default" \| "lg"`                                          | `"lg"`  | Large touch targets by default |

```ts
interface PaymentMethodConfig {
  id: "bml-transfer" | "bml-connect" | string // a project-defined method needs a label
  label?: string | { en?: string; dv?: string } // per locale
  description?: string | { en?: string; dv?: string }
  logo?: ReactNode // replaces the default logo or placeholder
  icon?: string // placeholder icon for a project-defined method
  aside?: ReactNode // e.g. a fee
  disabled?: boolean
}
```

Default labels and descriptions come from the `choice` locale namespace in English and Dhivehi.

## Accessibility

A `radiogroup` named "Payment method" (or your FormField label). Arrow keys move between cards (RTL aware); Space selects. Cards are at least 80px tall on touch screens.

---

<!-- docs/choice-inputs/bml-logos.md -->

# BML logos

Bank of Maldives' official logos, supplied by BML, as React components (R16.8). [`PaymentMethodSelector`](./payment-method-selector.md) shows them by default; use them anywhere else a payment method is shown, such as a checkout summary or a receipt.

- **`BmlTransferLogo`**: the BML logo (the red square). Use it for **BML Transfer**, bank transfers to a Bank of Maldives account.
- **`BmlConnectLogo`**: the BML Connect ("BML Payment Gateway") logo with the Visa, Mastercard and American Express marks. Use it for **BML Connect** card payments.

```tsx
import { BmlConnectLogo, BmlTransferLogo } from "@javaabu/onu"

<BmlTransferLogo className="size-8" />
<BmlConnectLogo className="h-8 rounded-md bg-white p-1" />

// Next to text that already names the method
<span className="flex items-center gap-2">
  <BmlConnectLogo decorative className="h-5 rounded-sm bg-white p-0.5" />
  BML Connect (Visa •••• 4242)
</span>
```

## Props

Both take every `<svg>` prop, plus:

| Prop         | Type      | Default                                    | Description                                                   |
| ------------ | --------- | ------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `title`      | `string`  | `"Bank of Maldives"` / `"BML Connect"`     | Accessible name (`role="img"`)                                |
| `decorative` | `boolean` | `false`                                    | Hide from assistive technology when visible text names it too |
| `className`  | `string`  | `size-10` / `h-10 w-auto`                  | Size with `size-*` or `h-*`; the artwork keeps its proportions |

## Accessibility

- Each logo is an image (`role="img"`) named by `title`: "Bank of Maldives" or "BML Connect".
- When visible text next to the logo already names the method, pass `decorative` so screen readers don't hear the name twice (`aria-hidden="true"`, no role).
- The logos are not interactive; put them inside the control (radio card, button, link) that names the choice.

## Light and dark

The BML Connect logo's card marks (the Mastercard wordmark and the Visa blue) need a light surface. On dark backgrounds put the logo on a white tile, for example `className="rounded-md bg-white p-1"`. `PaymentMethodSelector` uses a white tile for both logos in light and dark mode. The BML logo carries its own white margin and reads on any background.

## Notes

- The artwork is BML's, unchanged: only editor metadata was removed when inlining it. Gradient and clip ids are generated per instance, so several logos can share a page.
- The "BML Payment Gateway" wordmark is live text in Gilroy Bold, as in BML's file. Onu does not load Gilroy, so it falls back to the system's bold sans-serif (close metrics, a slightly different letterform). Load Gilroy in your app to match the original exactly. The wordmark always runs left to right, also on RTL pages.
- Do not recolour, crop or redraw the logos; follow BML's branding guidelines.

---

<!-- docs/choice-inputs/account-switcher.md -->

# Account switcher

Switch between your own account and accounts you act for: organisations and delegated individuals (e.g. the citizen portal's "Profile and delegation"). Shows the active account with its avatar; the list is grouped, searchable for long lists, and marks the current account.

```tsx
import { AccountSwitcher } from "@javaabu/onu"

;<AccountSwitcher
  accounts={[
    { id: "me", name: "Aishath Shifa", description: "A123456" },
    { id: "javaabu", name: "Javaabu Pvt Ltd", type: "organisation" },
    { id: "father", name: "Ahmed Rasheed", type: "delegated", description: "Delegated to you" },
  ]}
  value={accountId}
  onValueChange={(id) => switchTo(id)}
  footer={<a href="/delegations">Manage delegations</a>}
/>
```

## Props

| Prop                     | Type                                 | Default     | Description                                             |
| ------------------------ | ------------------------------------ | ----------- | ------------------------------------------------------- |
| `accounts`               | `Account[]`                          |             | `{ id, name, description?, avatar?, type?, disabled? }` |
| `value` / `defaultValue` | `string`                             | first       | Active account id                                       |
| `onValueChange`          | `(id, account) => void`              |             |                                                         |
| `searchable`             | `boolean \| "auto"`                  | `"auto"`    | Search field; `auto` = more than 5 accounts             |
| `thaana`                 | `ThaanaProp`                         |             | Thaana in the search field                              |
| `footer`                 | `ReactNode`                          |             | Below the list                                          |
| `size`                   | `"default" \| "lg"`                  | `"default"` |                                                         |
| `sheet`                  | `boolean`                            | `true`      | Bottom sheet on phones (searchable mode)                |
| `classNames`             | `{ trigger, content, item, avatar }` |             |                                                         |

`type` is `"personal"` (default), `"organisation"` or `"delegated"`; the list is grouped in that order. Avatars fall back to initials (or a building icon for organisations).

## Accessibility

The trigger is a button named "Switch account: {name}". Short lists open a Radix dropdown menu with `menuitemradio` items (arrow keys, typeahead, Escape). Searchable lists open a search `combobox` with a `listbox`; the current account is marked "Current account". Focus returns to the trigger on close.
