<!-- docs/choice-inputs/image-select.md -->

# Image select

A grid of image options: one choice (radio semantics) or several (`multiple`, checkbox semantics). Tiles fit the container width (`minItemWidth`), so the grid works in narrow columns and on phones.

```tsx
import { ImageSelect } from '@javaabu/onu';

<ImageSelect
  options={[
    { value: 'lagoon', label: 'Lagoon', src: '/themes/lagoon.jpg', alt: '' },
    { value: 'reef', label: 'Reef', src: '/themes/reef.jpg', alt: '' },
  ]}
  defaultValue="lagoon"
/>
<ImageSelect options={photos} multiple max={3} aspectRatio="video" name="covers" />
```

## Props

| Prop                     | Type                                          | Default    | Description                                           |
| ------------------------ | --------------------------------------------- | ---------- | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| `options`                | `ImageOption[]`                               |            | `{ value, label, src, alt, description?, disabled? }` |
| `multiple`               | `boolean`                                     | `false`    | Checkbox semantics                                    |
| `value` / `defaultValue` | `string \| null` (`string[]` when multiple)   |            |                                                       |
| `onValueChange`          | `(value) => void`                             |            |                                                       |
| `aspectRatio`            | `"square" \| "video" \| "portrait" \| number` | `"square"` | Image shape                                           |
| `minItemWidth`           | CSS length                                    | `"8rem"`   | Minimum tile width                                    |
| `showLabels`             | `boolean`                                     | `true`     | Labels under images                                   |
| `max`                    | `number`                                      |            | Multiple only                                         |
| `name`                   | `string`                                      |            | Form value (`name[]` when multiple)                   |
| `classNames`             | `{ item, image, label, indicator }`           |            |                                                       |

`alt` is required (R14.10); use `""` when the label already describes the image.

## Accessibility

Single: a `radiogroup` of `radio` tiles (arrow keys, RTL aware). Multiple: a `group` of `checkbox` tiles (Tab + Space). Tiles are named by their label.

<!-- docs/choice-inputs/quick-create-select.md -->

# Select with quick-create

A [searchable select](./searchable-select.md) that can create the option the user is looking for. When nothing matches the search exactly, a "Create “…”" row appears. Create inline with `onCreate`, or open your own dialog with `renderCreateDialog`. The new option is added, selected and announced. [API select](./api-select.md) accepts the same props (and refreshes its cache afterwards).

```tsx
import { QuickCreateSelect } from '@javaabu/onu';

// Inline
<QuickCreateSelect
  options={categories}
  onCreate={async (label) => {
    const { data } = await api.post('/categories', { name: label });
    return { value: String(data.id), label: data.name };
  }}
/>

// Through a dialog
<QuickCreateSelect
  options={vendors}
  renderCreateDialog={({ query, open, onOpenChange, onCreated }) => (
    <NewVendorDialog name={query} open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange} onSaved={(v) => onCreated({ value: v.id, label: v.name })} />
  )}
/>
```

## Props

All [Searchable select](./searchable-select.md) props (including `multiple`), plus:

| Prop                 | Type                                                       | Description                                      |
| -------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------ |
| `onCreate`           | `(label) => ChoiceOption \| Promise<ChoiceOption \| null>` | Create inline; return the new option             |
| `renderCreateDialog` | `({ query, open, onOpenChange, onCreated }) => ReactNode`  | Render your own dialog; call `onCreated(option)` |
| `onCreated`          | `(option) => void`                                         | After any create                                 |

While `onCreate` runs the row shows "Creating…"; if it throws, the row shows "Couldn’t create “…”" and can be tried again.

## Accessibility

The create row is a normal option (Enter selects it). "“…” created and selected" is announced. With a dialog, the popover closes first, so focus returns to the field when the dialog closes.

---

<!-- docs/files-and-media/file-input.md -->

# FileInput

A styled native file input. The real `<input type="file">` covers the trigger, so clicking, tapping, the keyboard (<kbd>Enter</kbd>/<kbd>Space</kbd>) and dropping a file onto it all work natively. It validates type and size with translated messages, lists the selection with remove buttons, and keeps the input's `files` in sync so a plain form submit sends what the user sees.

```tsx
import { FileInput } from "@javaabu/onu"

;<FileInput aria-label="Passport copy" accept=".pdf,image/*" maxSize={2 * 1024 * 1024} />
```

Inside a [`FormField`](../form-scaffolding/form-field.md) the input gets its `id`, `name`, `aria-describedby`, `aria-invalid`, `aria-required` and `disabled` from the field:

```tsx
<FormField label="National ID card" name="id_card" help="PDF or image, up to 2 MB." required>
  <FileInput accept=".pdf,image/*" maxSize={2 * 1024 * 1024} />
</FormField>
```

## Controlled

```tsx
const [files, setFiles] = React.useState<File[]>([])

<FileInput multiple value={files} onChange={setFiles} onReject={(rejections) => console.log(rejections)} />
```

## Validation

Picked files are checked against `accept`, `maxSize`, `minSize` and `maxFiles`. Rejected files are listed under the input in a polite live region ("photo.png is larger than 2 MB."), and passed to `onReject` as `{ file, code }` with `code` one of `file-too-large`, `file-too-small`, `file-invalid-type`, `too-many-files`. Sizes use the active locale (`1.5 MB`).

The helpers are exported too: `validateFile`, `validateFiles`, `matchesAccept`, `formatFileSize`, `getFileKind`, and the `useFormatFileSize()` hook.

## Props

| Prop           | Type                                                     | Default     | Description                                                             |
| -------------- | -------------------------------------------------------- | ----------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `value`        | `File[]`                                                 |             | Selected files (controlled)                                             |
| `defaultValue` | `File[]`                                                 | `[]`        | Initial files (uncontrolled)                                            |
| `onChange`     | `(files: File[]) => void`                                |             | Called with the full selection after a pick or a removal                |
| `onReject`     | `(rejections: FileRejection[]) => void`                  |             | Files that failed validation                                            |
| `accept`       | `string`                                                 |             | Accepted types, as for `<input accept>`                                 |
| `maxSize`      | `number`                                                 |             | Largest size in bytes                                                   |
| `minSize`      | `number`                                                 |             | Smallest size in bytes                                                  |
| `maxFiles`     | `number`                                                 |             | Most files in total                                                     |
| `multiple`     | `boolean`                                                | `false`     | Allow several files                                                     |
| `append`       | `boolean`                                                | `false`     | Add picks to the selection instead of replacing it (implies `multiple`) |
| `showList`     | `boolean`                                                | `true`      | Show the selected files with remove buttons                             |
| `size`         | `"sm" \| "default" \| "lg"`                              | `"default"` | Trigger size (`fileInputVariants`)                                      |
| `buttonLabel`  | `ReactNode`                                              |             | Button text (default "Choose file(s)")                                  |
| `placeholder`  | `string`                                                 |             | Text when nothing is selected                                           |
| `summary`      | `ReactNode`                                              |             | Replace the summary next to the button                                  |
| `pickDisabled` | `boolean`                                                | `false`     | Stop picking more files but keep removal working                        |
| `countOffset`  | `number`                                                 | `0`         | Files already counted towards `maxFiles` elsewhere                      |
| `classNames`   | `{ root, trigger, button, summary, list, item, errors }` |             | Classes for each part                                                   |

All other `<input>` props are passed to the input, and `ref` points at the `<input>`.

## Accessibility

- Give the input a label: a `FormField`, a `<label>`, or `aria-label`. The summary ("2 files selected") and any validation messages are linked with `aria-describedby`.
- Each selected file has a "Remove {name}" button; after removing, focus returns to the input.
- The trigger is at least 44px tall on touch screens.

| Key                                 | Action                     |
| ----------------------------------- | -------------------------- |
| <kbd>Enter</kbd> / <kbd>Space</kbd> | Open the file picker       |
| <kbd>Tab</kbd>                      | Move to the remove buttons |

## RTL and Dhivehi

The button sits at the inline start, so it moves to the right in RTL. File names are isolated with `<bdi>`, so Thaana and Latin names display correctly in either direction. All strings come from the `file` locale namespace.

---

<!-- docs/files-and-media/multiple-file-input.md -->

# MultipleFileInput

A [`FileInput`](./file-input.md) for several files: each pick adds to the list (duplicates are skipped), every file has a remove button, and an optional hint shows the limits with a live count ("3 of 5").

```tsx
import { MultipleFileInput } from "@javaabu/onu"

;<FormField label="Tender documents">
  <MultipleFileInput accept=".pdf,.xlsx,.docx" maxFiles={5} maxSize={10 * 1024 * 1024} />
</FormField>
```

When `maxFiles` is reached the picker is disabled until a file is removed; extra files from one pick are rejected with "x.pdf was not added: only 5 files are allowed."

## Props

Takes every [`FileInput`](./file-input.md) prop except `multiple` and `append` (always on), plus:

| Prop         | Type      | Default | Description                                     |
| ------------ | --------- | ------- | ----------------------------------------------- |
| `showLimits` | `boolean` | `true`  | Show "Up to 5 files · 10 MB max each" and count |

## Accessibility

The count is announced politely as it changes. See [`FileInput`](./file-input.md) for the keyboard table.

## RTL and Dhivehi

As for `FileInput`; the limits hint uses plural rules for both locales.

---

<!-- docs/files-and-media/instant-file-upload.md -->

# InstantFileUpload

Uploads each file as soon as it is chosen, with a progress bar per file, cancel, retry and remove. When an upload succeeds its id is written to a hidden input, so the surrounding form submits ids instead of files (the usual "temporary upload" pattern in Laravel apps).

```tsx
import { InstantFileUpload } from "@javaabu/onu"

// Built-in XHR uploader (XHR is the only browser API that reports upload progress)
;<FormField label="Transfer slip" name="slip_id">
  <InstantFileUpload
    url="/api/uploads"
    uploadOptions={{ headers: { "X-CSRF-TOKEN": csrfToken }, fieldName: "file" }}
    accept="image/*,.pdf"
    maxSize={5 * 1024 * 1024}
  />
</FormField>
```

Or bring your own uploader (axios, Inertia, S3 pre-signed URLs, …):

```tsx
<InstantFileUpload
  multiple
  upload={async (file, { onProgress, signal }) => {
    const { data } = await axios.post("/uploads", toFormData(file), {
      signal,
      onUploadProgress: (e) => onProgress(Math.round((e.loaded / (e.total ?? 1)) * 100)),
    })
    return data
  }}
  onUploaded={(item) => console.log(item.response)}
/>
```

## Built-in uploader

`url` uses `xhrUpload` / `createXhrUploader`: it posts `FormData` with the file under `fieldName` (default `file`) plus `data`, sends `Accept: application/json` and `X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest`, and resolves with the parsed JSON. Non-2xx responses reject with an `UploadError` carrying `status`, Laravel's `errors`, and a message taken from `errors[fieldName][0]` (or `message`). That message is shown on the file. CSRF and auth are the app's concern (pass headers or `withCredentials`).

The hidden input's value comes from `getValue(response)`, or by default from `id`, `uuid` or `data.id`.

## Props

Takes the [`FileInput`](./file-input.md) props (`accept`, `maxSize`, `multiple`, `size`, …) except `value`/`onChange`, plus:

| Prop            | Type                                                    | Default                   | Description                                          |
| --------------- | ------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------- |
| `upload`        | `(file, { onProgress, signal }) => Promise`             |                           | Your uploader                                        |
| `url`           | `string`                                                |                           | Endpoint for the built-in XHR uploader               |
| `uploadOptions` | `{ method, fieldName, headers, data, withCredentials }` |                           | Options for the built-in uploader                    |
| `onUploaded`    | `(item: UploadItem) => void`                            |                           | A file finished; `item.response` holds the response  |
| `onError`       | `(item, error) => void`                                 |                           | A file failed (not called on cancel)                 |
| `onItemsChange` | `(items: UploadItem[]) => void`                         |                           | The upload list changed                              |
| `name`          | `string`                                                | FormField's `name`        | Name for hidden id inputs (`name[]` when `multiple`) |
| `getValue`      | `(response) => string \| number \| null`                | `id` / `uuid` / `data.id` | Value submitted for each upload                      |
| `classNames`    | FileInput's `classNames` + `{ progress }`               |                           | Classes for each part                                |

`useUploadQueue(options)` exposes the same logic (`items`, `add`, `cancel`, `retry`, `remove`, `clear`, `announcement`) for custom layouts. Uploads still running when the component unmounts are aborted.

## Accessibility

- Progress bars are named "Upload progress for {name}" and expose `aria-valuenow`.
- Starts, completions, cancellations and failures are announced in a polite live region.
- Cancel, retry and remove buttons are named with the file ("Retry upload of slip.pdf"). Removing returns focus to the input.

| Key                                 | Action                                                |
| ----------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| <kbd>Enter</kbd> / <kbd>Space</kbd> | Choose files / press a cancel, retry or remove button |

## RTL and Dhivehi

Progress bars fill from the inline start, so from the right in RTL. All strings come from the `file` namespace.

---

<!-- docs/files-and-media/upload-progress.md -->

# UploadProgress

A list of uploads, each with its name, size, progress bar, status (waiting, uploading, uploaded, failed, cancelled) and cancel / retry / remove buttons. Pair it with `useUploadQueue`, or render your own states.

```tsx
import { UploadProgress, useUploadQueue } from "@javaabu/onu"

const queue = useUploadQueue({ url: "/api/uploads", uploadOptions: { headers } })

<input type="file" multiple onChange={(e) => queue.add(Array.from(e.target.files ?? []))} />
<UploadProgress
  items={queue.items}
  onCancel={queue.cancel}
  onRetry={queue.retry}
  onRemove={queue.remove}
  announcement={queue.announcement}
/>
```

A single row is available as `UploadProgressItem`:

```tsx
<ul>
  <UploadProgressItem name="Budget.xlsx" size={140_000} progress={0} status="error" error="Too big" onRetry={retry} />
</ul>
```

## Props

`UploadProgress`

| Prop           | Type                                  | Description                                         |
| -------------- | ------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------- |
| `items`        | `UploadItem[]`                        | `{ id, file, status, progress, error?, response? }` |
| `onCancel`     | `(id) => void`                        | Shown while queued/uploading                        |
| `onRetry`      | `(id) => void`                        | Shown after an error or cancel                      |
| `onRemove`     | `(id) => void`                        | Shown when not busy                                 |
| `announcement` | `string`                              | Text for a polite `role="status"` region            |
| `classNames`   | `{ item, progress, status, actions }` | Classes for each part                               |

`UploadProgressItem` takes `name`, `size`, `type`, `file` (for a thumbnail), `progress`, `status`, `error`, `onCancel`, `onRetry`, `onRemove` and `classNames`.

`useUploadQueue({ upload | url, uploadOptions, onUploaded, onError, onItemsChange })` returns `{ items, add, cancel, retry, remove, clear, announcement, canUpload }`.

## Accessibility

The list is labelled "Uploads"; each progress bar is named and exposes its value; errors use an icon and text, not colour alone. Buttons are named with the file.

| Key                                 | Action                  |
| ----------------------------------- | ----------------------- |
| <kbd>Tab</kbd>                      | Move between buttons    |
| <kbd>Enter</kbd> / <kbd>Space</kbd> | Cancel, retry or remove |

## RTL and Dhivehi

Progress bars fill from the inline start; names are isolated with `<bdi>`.

---

<!-- docs/files-and-media/dropzone-uploader.md -->

# DropzoneUploader

A drag-and-drop zone built on [`react-dropzone`](https://react-dropzone.js.org), with a "Browse files" button as the keyboard and touch alternative, paste from the clipboard, validation messages, and an upload progress list when given an uploader.

```tsx
import { DropzoneUploader } from "@javaabu/onu"

;<FormField label="Project photos" name="photos">
  <DropzoneUploader
    url="/api/uploads"
    uploadOptions={{ headers: { "X-CSRF-TOKEN": token } }}
    accept="image/*,.pdf"
    maxFiles={6}
    maxSize={8 * 1024 * 1024}
    description="Images or PDF, up to 8 MB each"
  />
</FormField>
```

Without `upload` or `url` it just collects files:

```tsx
<DropzoneUploader multiple onChange={setFiles} pasteFromDocument />
```

## Existing files and a controlled value

Pass the files already saved on the record as `defaultValue` (or `value` with `onValueChange` to control it). Each is `{ id, name, size?, type?, url?, thumbnailUrl? }` — the same shape as [`AdditionalFilesUpload`](./additional-files-upload.md)'s `existing` attachments. They are listed with an "Open" link (when `url` is set) and a remove button, and their ids are submitted as hidden inputs under `name` (`name[]` when `multiple`), so an edit page shows the saved files and the server receives the ones the user kept.

```tsx
const [documents, setDocuments] = useState<DropzoneFile[]>(application.documents)

<FormField label="Supporting documents" name="documents">
  <DropzoneUploader url="/api/uploads" value={documents} onValueChange={setDocuments} />
</FormField>
```

- **With an uploader** (`upload` / `url`), a finished upload is added to the value as `{ id, name, size, type, file, response }`, where `id` comes from `getValue(response)` (default: `id`, `uuid` or `data.id`). Uploads still in progress are not in the value. Removing a finished upload, or the parent dropping it from `value`, removes it from the list. With `multiple={false}` a finished upload replaces the value.
- **Without an uploader**, picked `File`s are added to the value next to the existing entries (`onChange` still receives just the `File`s).
- Existing files count toward `maxFiles`.
- Without `value` and `defaultValue` the uploader works as before.

## Paste

Files pasted while the zone (or its button) has focus are added. With `pasteFromDocument`, files pasted anywhere on the page are added too, which is handy for screenshots.

## Props

| Prop                                       | Type                                                       | Default | Description                                          |
| ------------------------------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------- | ------- | ---------------------------------------------------- |
| `upload` / `url` / `uploadOptions`         |                                                            |         | Same as [`InstantFileUpload`](./instant-file-upload.md) |
| `accept`, `maxSize`, `minSize`, `maxFiles` |                                                            |         | Validation, as for [`FileInput`](./file-input.md)       |
| `multiple`                                 | `boolean`                                                  | `true`  | Allow several files                                  |
| `disabled`                                 | `boolean`                                                  |         | Disable dropping, browsing and pasting               |
| `onFilesAdded`                             | `(files: File[]) => void`                                  |         | Every accepted batch                                 |
| `onChange`                                 | `(files: File[]) => void`                                  |         | Collected files (without an uploader)                |
| `value` / `defaultValue`                   | `DropzoneFile[]`                                           |         | Files the field holds: `File`s and `{ id, name, … }` |
| `onValueChange`                            | `(value: DropzoneFile[]) => void`                          |         | Files added, finished uploading or removed           |
| `onReject`                                 | `(rejections) => void`                                     |         | Files that failed validation                         |
| `onUploaded`, `onError`, `onItemsChange`   |                                                            |         | Upload callbacks                                     |
| `pasteFromDocument`                        | `boolean`                                                  | `false` | Accept files pasted anywhere on the page             |
| `title`, `description`, `icon`             | `ReactNode`                                                |         | Zone content                                         |
| `showList`                                 | `boolean`                                                  | `true`  | Show the file / progress list                        |
| `name`, `getValue`                         |                                                            |         | Hidden inputs for uploaded and existing ids          |
| `size`                                     | `"sm" \| "default" \| "lg"`                                |         | Padding (`dropzoneVariants`)                         |
| `classNames`                               | `{ zone, icon, title, description, button, list, errors }` |         | Classes for each part                                |

## Accessibility

- The zone itself is not a tab stop; the "Browse files" button inside it is, and carries the FormField's label, description and invalid state.
- While dragging, the zone shows "Drop to upload" with a highlighted border (not colour alone: the text changes too).
- Validation messages and upload results are announced politely.
- Every file has a "Remove {name}" button. After removing one, focus returns to the "Browse files" button and "{name} removed" is announced.

| Key                                         | Action                         |
| ------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------ |
| <kbd>Enter</kbd> / <kbd>Space</kbd>         | Open the file picker (button)  |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>/<kbd>Cmd</kbd>+<kbd>V</kbd> | Paste files from the clipboard |

## RTL and Dhivehi

Content is centred, so it reads the same in both directions; all text comes from the `file` namespace.

---

<!-- docs/files-and-media/additional-files-upload.md -->

# AdditionalFilesUpload

Manages a record's attachments on an edit page: existing files can be removed (and restored before saving), and new files can be added, each with an optional display name and description.

```tsx
import { AdditionalFilesUpload, type AdditionalFilesValue } from "@javaabu/onu"

const [value, setValue] = React.useState<AdditionalFilesValue>({ removed: [], added: [] })

<FormField label="Attachments">
  <AdditionalFilesUpload
    existing={[{ id: 11, name: "Lease agreement.pdf", url: "/media/11", size: 482_000 }]}
    value={value}
    onChange={setValue}
    maxFiles={6}
    thaana
  />
</FormField>
```

`value.removed` holds the ids of existing files to delete and `value.added` the new files as `{ key, file, name, description }`.

## Plain form submits

Set `name` to also render native fields: `name[removed][]` (hidden ids), `name[added][0][file]` (a hidden file input holding the file), `name[added][0][name]` and `name[added][0][description]`. Laravel reads these as nested arrays.

## Props

| Prop                                       | Type                                    | Default | Description                                                     |
| ------------------------------------------ | --------------------------------------- | ------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `existing`                                 | `ExistingAttachment[]`                  | `[]`    | `{ id, name, url?, size?, type?, thumbnailUrl?, description? }` |
| `value`                                    | `AdditionalFilesValue`                  |         | Controlled value                                                |
| `defaultValue`                             | `AdditionalFilesValue`                  |         | Initial value                                                   |
| `onChange`                                 | `(value) => void`                       |         | Called on every change                                          |
| `withName`                                 | `boolean`                               | `true`  | Ask for a display name per new file                             |
| `withDescription`                          | `boolean`                               | `true`  | Ask for a description per new file                              |
| `thaana`                                   | `boolean \| ThaanaOptions`              |         | Thaana typing in the name and description fields                |
| `accept`, `maxSize`, `minSize`, `onReject` |                                         |         | Validation                                                      |
| `maxFiles`                                 | `number`                                |         | Most attachments in total (kept + new)                          |
| `disabled`                                 | `boolean`                               |         | Disable all actions                                             |
| `name`                                     | `string`                                |         | Prefix for native form fields                                   |
| `classNames`                               | `{ list, item, fields, picker, empty }` |         | Classes for each part                                           |

## Accessibility

- Each file's buttons are named with the file ("Remove Lease agreement.pdf", "Restore …").
- Marking a file for removal shows "Will be removed" as text (not only a strike-through), announces it, and moves focus to the Restore button.
- Removing a new file returns focus to the "Add files" picker.

| Key                                          | Action                                                 |
| -------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------ |
| <kbd>Enter</kbd> / <kbd>Space</kbd>          | Add files, remove, restore                             |
| <kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>T</kbd> | Toggle Thaana in the text fields (when `thaana` is on) |

## RTL and Dhivehi

The name and description fields sit side by side in wide containers and stack in narrow ones (container query). With `thaana`, they type Thaana and switch to `dir="rtl"`.

---

<!-- docs/files-and-media/image-input.md -->

# ImageInput

Picks one image with a preview, and Replace / Remove buttons. The value can be a picked `File` or the URL of an existing image.

```tsx
import { ImageInput } from "@javaabu/onu"

;<FormField label="Guest house photo" name="photo">
  <ImageInput
    alt="Guest house in Maafushi"
    defaultValue={guestHouse.photoUrl}
    removeName="remove_photo"
    maxSize={2 * 1024 * 1024}
  />
</FormField>
```

When an existing image is removed, `removeName` renders a hidden input set to `1` so the server knows to delete it.

## Props

| Prop           | Type                                              | Default                | Description                                               |
| -------------- | ------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------- |
| `alt`          | `string`                                          | (required)             | Alt text for the preview (R14.10)                         |
| `value`        | `File \| string \| null`                          |                        | Controlled value                                          |
| `defaultValue` | `File \| string \| null`                          |                        | Initial value                                             |
| `onChange`     | `(file: File \| null) => void`                    |                        | New file, or `null` when removed                          |
| `onReject`     | `(rejection) => void`                             |                        | A picked file failed validation                           |
| `accept`       | `string`                                          | `"image/*"`            | Accepted types                                            |
| `maxSize`      | `number`                                          |                        | Largest size in bytes                                     |
| `shape`        | `"rounded" \| "square" \| "circle"`               | `"rounded"`            | Preview shape (`imageInputVariants`)                      |
| `aspectRatio`  | `number`                                          | `4/3` (`1` for circle) | Preview aspect ratio                                      |
| `removeName`   | `string`                                          |                        | Hidden input set to `1` when an existing image is removed |
| `placeholder`  | `ReactNode`                                       |                        | Empty-state content                                       |
| `classNames`   | `{ root, preview, image, actions, empty, error }` |                        | Classes for each part                                     |

Other `<input>` props go to the (visually hidden) file input; `ref` points at it.

## Accessibility

- The empty state is a button ("Choose an image"); with an image, the preview has the `alt` text and the actions are "Replace" and "Remove". After removing, focus moves to the choose button.
- Validation errors use `role="alert"` and are linked to the buttons with `aria-describedby`.

| Key                                 | Action                    |
| ----------------------------------- | ------------------------- |
| <kbd>Enter</kbd> / <kbd>Space</kbd> | Choose, replace or remove |

## RTL and Dhivehi

Buttons follow the reading direction; strings come from the `file` namespace.

---

<!-- docs/files-and-media/avatar-upload.md -->

# AvatarUpload

A circular avatar picker: shows the photo (or initials), opens a crop step after picking (using [`ImageCropper`](./image-cropper.md)), and offers Change and Remove. It lives in the optional media entry because it uses `react-easy-crop`.

```bash
pnpm add react-easy-crop
```

```tsx
import { AvatarUpload } from "@javaabu/onu/media"

;<FormField label="Profile photo" name="avatar">
  <AvatarUpload personName="Aishath Shifa" defaultValue={user.avatarUrl} maxSize={5 * 1024 * 1024} />
</FormField>
```

The cropped image is a square JPEG, 512px by default (`cropOptions`), returned as a `File` through `onChange` and kept on the hidden file input for plain form submits. If cropping fails (for example a cross-origin image), the original file is used.

## Props

| Prop           | Type                                 | Default     | Description                             |
| -------------- | ------------------------------------ | ----------- | --------------------------------------- |
| `personName`   | `string`                             | (required)  | Used for the initials and the alt text  |
| `value`        | `File \| string \| null`             |             | Controlled value                        |
| `defaultValue` | `File \| string \| null`             |             | Initial value                           |
| `onChange`     | `(file: File \| null) => void`       |             | New (cropped) file, or `null`           |
| `onReject`     | `(rejection) => void`                |             | A picked file failed validation         |
| `accept`       | `string`                             | `"image/*"` | Accepted types                          |
| `maxSize`      | `number`                             |             | Largest size in bytes (before cropping) |
| `crop`         | `boolean`                            | `true`      | Show the crop step                      |
| `cropOptions`  | `CropImageOptions`                   | 512px JPEG  | `{ type, quality, maxSize }`            |
| `removable`    | `boolean`                            | `true`      | Show the Remove button                  |
| `size`         | `"sm" \| "default" \| "lg" \| "xl"`  | `"default"` | Avatar size (`avatarUploadVariants`)    |
| `classNames`   | `{ avatar, actions, dialog, error }` |             | Classes for each part                   |

## Accessibility

- The avatar image is named "Photo of {name}"; without a photo the initials are exposed as "{name} (no photo)".
- The crop dialog traps focus; Cancel or Escape closes it and focus returns to the Change/Upload button.
- See [`ImageCropper`](./image-cropper.md) for the crop keyboard support.

| Key                                 | Action                  |
| ----------------------------------- | ----------------------- |
| <kbd>Enter</kbd> / <kbd>Space</kbd> | Upload/change or remove |
| <kbd>Escape</kbd>                   | Cancel the crop dialog  |

## RTL and Dhivehi

Initials work with Thaana names ("އަޙްމަދު ނާޒިމް" → "އނ"). The layout mirrors in RTL.

---

<!-- docs/files-and-media/image-cropper.md -->

# ImageCropper

Crops an image with [`react-easy-crop`](https://github.com/ValentinH/react-easy-crop): drag or pinch to move and zoom, arrow keys to nudge, a zoom slider, rotation, aspect-ratio presets, and Blob/File output. Part of the optional media entry.

```bash
pnpm add react-easy-crop
```

```tsx
import { ImageCropper, type ImageCropperHandle } from "@javaabu/onu/media"

const cropper = React.useRef<ImageCropperHandle>(null)

<ImageCropper
  ref={cropper}
  src={file}
  alt="Shop front"
  aspect={16 / 9}
  aspectOptions={[
    { label: "16:9", value: 16 / 9 },
    { label: "1:1", value: 1 },
    { label: "Free", value: undefined },
  ]}
/>
<Button onClick={async () => upload(await cropper.current!.getFile("cover.jpg", { maxSize: 1600 }))}>Save</Button>
```

The canvas helpers are exported for use without the component: `cropImage(src, pixelCrop, { rotation, type, quality, maxSize })` returns a `Blob`, and `cropImageToFile(...)` a `File`.

## Props

| Prop                  | Type                                   | Default    | Description                                                          |
| --------------------- | -------------------------------------- | ---------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `src`                 | `string \| Blob`                       |            | Image URL or picked file                                             |
| `alt`                 | `string`                               | (required) | Names the crop area                                                  |
| `aspect`              | `number`                               | `1`        | Initial aspect ratio                                                 |
| `aspectOptions`       | `{ label, value }[]`                   |            | Aspect presets (`undefined` = free, image ratio)                     |
| `onAspectChange`      | `(aspect) => void`                     |            | A preset was chosen                                                  |
| `cropShape`           | `"rect" \| "round"`                    | `"rect"`   | Crop shape                                                           |
| `minZoom` / `maxZoom` | `number`                               | `1` / `3`  | Zoom range                                                           |
| `rotatable`           | `boolean`                              | `true`     | Show rotate buttons and slider                                       |
| `keyboardStep`        | `number`                               | `4`        | Pixels per arrow key press                                           |
| `onCropComplete`      | `(area: PixelCrop, rotation) => void`  |            | The crop changed                                                     |
| `ref`                 | `Ref<ImageCropperHandle>`              |            | `getBlob(options)`, `getFile(name, options)`, `getCrop()`, `reset()` |
| `classNames`          | `{ stage, controls, cropArea, media }` |            | Classes for each part                                                |

## Accessibility

The crop area is focusable, named "Crop area for {alt}" and described with the keyboard help. Zoom and rotation also have sliders and buttons, so nothing depends on dragging or pinching.

| Key                                                       | Action                        |
| --------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------- |
| Arrow keys                                                | Move the image (Shift: finer) |
| <kbd>+</kbd> / <kbd>-</kbd>                               | Zoom in / out                 |
| Arrow keys / <kbd>Home</kbd> / <kbd>End</kbd> on a slider | Change zoom or rotation       |

## RTL and Dhivehi

Sliders follow the reading direction; labels come from the `file` namespace.

---

<!-- docs/files-and-media/media-lister.md -->

# MediaLister

A media library: grid or list view, search, single or multiple selection, type icons and lazy thumbnails, with infinite or paged loading driven by props (fetch the data however you like).

```tsx
import { MediaLister } from "@javaabu/onu"

const { data, fetchNextPage, hasNextPage, isFetching } = useInfiniteQuery(...)

<MediaLister
  items={data.pages.flatMap((p) => p.data)}
  selectionMode="multiple"
  selected={selected}
  onSelectedChange={setSelected}
  search={search}
  onSearchChange={setSearch}
  hasMore={hasNextPage}
  loading={isFetching}
  onLoadMore={fetchNextPage}
/>
```

Without `onSearchChange`, `items` are filtered by name locally. For paged APIs pass `page`, `pageCount` and `onPageChange` instead of `hasMore`/`onLoadMore` (Laravel paginator `meta.current_page` / `meta.last_page`).

## Props

| Prop                                                | Type                                               | Default          | Description                                                |
| --------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------- | ---------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- |
| `items`                                             | `MediaItem[]`                                      |                  | `{ id, name, url?, thumbnailUrl?, alt?, type?, size? }`    |
| `view` / `defaultView` / `onViewChange`             | `"grid" \| "list"`                                 | `"grid"`         | View mode                                                  |
| `search` / `defaultSearch` / `onSearchChange`       | `string`                                           |                  | Search text; pass `onSearchChange` to search on the server |
| `hideSearch`                                        | `boolean`                                          | `false`          | Hide the search box                                        |
| `searchThaana`                                      | `boolean \| ThaanaOptions`                         |                  | Thaana typing in the search box                            |
| `selectionMode`                                     | `"none" \| "single" \| "multiple"`                 | `"none"`         | Selection behaviour                                        |
| `selected` / `defaultSelected` / `onSelectedChange` | `MediaId[]`                                        |                  | Selected ids                                               |
| `onItemOpen`                                        | `(item) => void`                                   |                  | Item activated (in `none` mode)                            |
| `renderActions`                                     | `(item) => ReactNode`                              |                  | Extra buttons per item (always visible)                    |
| `loading`                                           | `boolean`                                          |                  | Show skeletons and disable "Load more"                     |
| `hasMore` / `onLoadMore` / `infinite`               |                                                    | `infinite: true` | Infinite loading (scroll + button)                         |
| `page` / `pageCount` / `onPageChange`               | `number`                                           |                  | Paged loading                                              |
| `emptyMessage`                                      | `ReactNode`                                        |                  | Empty state text                                           |
| `toolbar`                                           | `ReactNode`                                        |                  | Extra toolbar content                                      |
| `label`                                             | `string`                                           | "Media library"  | Accessible name of the list                                |
| `classNames`                                        | `{ toolbar, list, item, thumbnail, name, footer }` |                  | Classes for each part                                      |

## Accessibility

- Items are buttons; in selection modes they are toggle buttons with `aria-pressed`, and the selected state is also shown with a check mark.
- The selection count ("3 selected") and loading are announced in a polite status region.
- Infinite loading always has a "Load more" button as well, so it works without scrolling.

| Key                                 | Action                         |
| ----------------------------------- | ------------------------------ |
| <kbd>Tab</kbd>                      | Move between items and actions |
| <kbd>Enter</kbd> / <kbd>Space</kbd> | Open or (de)select an item     |

## RTL and Dhivehi

The grid uses container queries (2 → 6 columns). Thaana search works with `searchThaana`; local filtering uses the active locale.
File names take their own direction (`dir="auto"`), so a Latin name in an RTL page is cut at its own end; sizes such as "248 KB" are forced left-to-right. AttachmentPreview, DocumentDownload, FileInput and the upload lists do the same.

---

<!-- docs/files-and-media/gallery.md -->

# Gallery

A responsive image grid or masonry layout. Thumbnails are lazy-loaded; activating one opens the [`Lightbox`](./lightbox.md) (keyboard, swipe, zoom), and focus returns to the thumbnail when it closes. Part of the optional media entry.

```bash
pnpm add yet-another-react-lightbox
```

```tsx
import { Gallery } from "@javaabu/onu/media"

;<Gallery
  images={[
    { src: "/photos/maafushi.jpg", thumbnail: "/photos/maafushi-sm.jpg", alt: "Maafushi beach", title: "Maafushi" },
    { src: "/photos/fuvahmulah.jpg", alt: "Sunset over Fuvahmulah", width: 900, height: 1200 },
  ]}
  layout="masonry"
  columns={4}
  showCaptions
/>
```

## Props

| Prop            | Type                                         | Default    | Description                                  |
| --------------- | -------------------------------------------- | ---------- | -------------------------------------------- |
| `images`        | `GalleryImage[]`                             |            | Lightbox slides plus an optional `thumbnail` |
| `layout`        | `"grid" \| "masonry"`                        | `"grid"`   | Layout (`galleryVariants`)                   |
| `columns`       | `2 \| 3 \| 4`                                | `3`        | Columns at wide container sizes              |
| `aspect`        | `"square" \| "video" \| "portrait"`          | `"square"` | Thumbnail shape in the grid                  |
| `showCaptions`  | `boolean`                                    | `false`    | Show each image's title under it             |
| `lightbox`      | `boolean`                                    | `true`     | Open the lightbox on click                   |
| `lightboxProps` | `{ zoom, captions, counter, loop, plugins }` |            | Lightbox options                             |
| `onImageClick`  | `(index) => void`                            |            | An image was activated                       |
| `classNames`    | `{ list, item, image, caption }`             |            | Classes for each part                        |

## Accessibility

Each thumbnail is a button named by its alt text (required, R14.10) with `aria-haspopup="dialog"`.

| Key                                 | Action            |
| ----------------------------------- | ----------------- |
| <kbd>Enter</kbd> / <kbd>Space</kbd> | Open the lightbox |

See [`Lightbox`](./lightbox.md) for keys inside the viewer.

## RTL and Dhivehi

The grid flows from the inline start; columns adapt to the container (container queries).

<!-- docs/files-and-media/lightbox.md -->

# Lightbox

A full-screen image viewer built on [yet-another-react-lightbox](https://yet-another-react-lightbox.com): keyboard, swipe, pinch/double-tap/wheel zoom, captions and a counter, with a focus trap, focus return, translated labels and mirrored arrows in RTL. Part of the optional media entry. Use [`Gallery`](./gallery.md) for the thumbnail grid.

```bash
pnpm add yet-another-react-lightbox
```

```tsx
import { Lightbox } from "@javaabu/onu/media"

const [open, setOpen] = React.useState(false)
const [index, setIndex] = React.useState(0)

<Button onClick={() => setOpen(true)}>View photos</Button>
<Lightbox
  open={open}
  onOpenChange={setOpen}
  slides={[{ src: "/photos/1.jpg", alt: "Malé skyline", title: "Malé", description: "From the Hulhumalé ferry" }]}
  index={index}
  onIndexChange={setIndex}
/>
```

:::info

The component imports the library's CSS (`yet-another-react-lightbox/styles.css` and the captions/counter plugin styles). Bundlers such as Vite and Next.js handle this automatically. Colours are bound to Onu tokens through the library's CSS variables, so the viewer follows light and dark mode.

:::

## Props

| Prop            | Type              | Default | Description                                                    |
| --------------- | ----------------- | ------- | -------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `open`          | `boolean`         |         | Whether the viewer is open                                     |
| `onOpenChange`  | `(open) => void`  |         | Called with `false` on close                                   |
| `slides`        | `LightboxSlide[]` |         | `{ src, alt, title?, description?, width?, height?, srcSet? }` |
| `index`         | `number`          | `0`     | Slide to show                                                  |
| `onIndexChange` | `(index) => void` |         | The slide changed                                              |
| `zoom`          | `boolean`         | `true`  | Zoom plugin                                                    |
| `captions`      | `boolean`         | `true`  | Captions plugin                                                |
| `counter`       | `boolean`         | `true`  | "2 / 8" counter                                                |
| `loop`          | `boolean`         | `false` | Wrap around                                                    |
| `plugins`       | `Plugin[]`        |         | Extra library plugins (thumbnails, slideshow, …)               |
| `className`     | `string`          |         | Class on the viewer root                                       |

## Accessibility

The viewer is a modal dialog ("Image viewer"); slides are announced as "2 of 8"; focus is trapped while open and returns to the element that opened it. Every gesture has a button alternative.

| Key                   | Action                            |
| --------------------- | --------------------------------- |
| <kbd>ArrowRight</kbd> | Next image (previous in RTL)      |
| <kbd>ArrowLeft</kbd>  | Previous image (next in RTL)      |
| <kbd>Escape</kbd>     | Close                             |
| <kbd>Tab</kbd>        | Move between the viewer's buttons |

## RTL and Dhivehi

The arrows swap sides and the keys follow the reading direction in RTL (the viewer reads the document's `dir`, which `OnuProvider` sets). Labels come from the `file` namespace.

---

<!-- docs/files-and-media/carousel.md -->

# Carousel

shadcn's Carousel (Embla) extended with RTL direction, translated controls, dot navigation, autoplay with a pause button, and slide announcements. Swipe works on touch out of the box. Compose it with the shadcn parts.

```tsx
import {
  Carousel,
  CarouselAutoplayToggle,
  CarouselContent,
  CarouselDots,
  CarouselItem,
  CarouselNext,
  CarouselPrevious,
} from "@javaabu/onu"

;<Carousel label="Featured islands" autoplay={{ delay: 4000 }} loop>
  <CarouselContent>
    {photos.map((p) => (
      <CarouselItem key={p.src}>
        <img src={p.src} alt={p.alt} loading="lazy" />
      </CarouselItem>
    ))}
  </CarouselContent>
  <CarouselPrevious />
  <CarouselNext />
  <div className="gap-2 flex items-center justify-center">
    <CarouselAutoplayToggle />
    <CarouselDots />
  </div>
</Carousel>
```

:::info

`Carousel` replaces shadcn's primitive of the same name in the main export. The plain primitive is still available from `@javaabu/onu/primitives`; `CarouselContent`, `CarouselItem`, `CarouselPrevious` and `CarouselNext` are shared.

:::

## Autoplay

Autoplay advances every `delay` ms and wraps to the first slide. It pauses while the pointer is over the carousel or focus is inside it, never runs with `prefers-reduced-motion`, and `CarouselAutoplayToggle` pauses it for good (WCAG 2.2.2). With `stopOnInteraction`, swiping or using the controls stops it.

## Props

`Carousel` takes shadcn's props (`opts`, `plugins`, `orientation`, `setApi`) plus:

| Prop       | Type                                        | Default | Description                   |
| ---------- | ------------------------------------------- | ------- | ----------------------------- |
| `label`    | `string`                                    |         | Accessible name of the region |
| `autoplay` | `boolean \| { delay?, stopOnInteraction? }` | `false` | Advance automatically         |
| `loop`     | `boolean`                                   |         | Wrap around                   |

`CarouselDots` takes `classNames={{ dot }}`; `CarouselAutoplayToggle` takes Button props. `useCarouselState()` returns `{ api, selected, count, playing, setPlaying }`.

## Accessibility

The root is a `region` with `aria-roledescription="carousel"`; slides are groups. "Slide 2 of 5" is announced politely when the slide changes (silenced while autoplaying). Dots are buttons ("Go to slide 3") with `aria-current` on the active one, and at least 44px on touch screens.

| Key                   | Action                       |
| --------------------- | ---------------------------- |
| <kbd>ArrowRight</kbd> | Next slide (previous in RTL) |
| <kbd>ArrowLeft</kbd>  | Previous slide (next in RTL) |
| <kbd>Tab</kbd>        | Move to the buttons and dots |

## RTL and Dhivehi

Embla gets `direction: "rtl"` from `OnuProvider`, so slides lay out and swipe right-to-left, arrow keys follow the visual order, and the prev/next icons mirror. Labels come from the locale.

---

<!-- docs/files-and-media/attachment-preview.md -->

# AttachmentPreview

A file attachment: thumbnail or type icon, name, type and size, with open, download and remove actions. Images and PDFs can be previewed in a dialog.

```tsx
import { AttachmentPreview } from "@javaabu/onu"

<AttachmentPreview name="Council gazette.pdf" url="/media/gazette.pdf" size={240_000} onRemove={remove} />
<AttachmentPreview variant="card" name="Harbour.jpg" url="/media/harbour.jpg" alt="Malé harbour at dusk" />
```

## Props

| Prop           | Type                                         | Default | Description                            |
| -------------- | -------------------------------------------- | ------- | -------------------------------------- |
| `name`         | `string`                                     |         | File name                              |
| `url`          | `string`                                     |         | Where the file opens / previews        |
| `downloadUrl`  | `string`                                     | `url`   | Download link                          |
| `size`         | `number`                                     |         | Size in bytes                          |
| `type`         | `string`                                     |         | MIME type (else the extension is used) |
| `thumbnailUrl` | `string`                                     |         | Thumbnail; images use `url`            |
| `alt`          | `string`                                     | `name`  | Thumbnail alt text                     |
| `preview`      | `boolean`                                    | `true`  | Preview images and PDFs in a dialog    |
| `onRemove`     | `() => void`                                 |         | Show a remove button                   |
| `actions`      | `ReactNode`                                  |         | Extra actions                          |
| `variant`      | `"row" \| "card"`                            | `"row"` | Layout (`attachmentPreviewVariants`)   |
| `classNames`   | `{ thumbnail, name, meta, actions, dialog }` |         | Classes for each part                  |

## Accessibility

Actions are named with the file ("Preview Council gazette.pdf", "Download …"). The preview is a dialog titled with the file name; it traps focus, closes with <kbd>Escape</kbd> or the Close button, and returns focus to the Preview button. PDFs are shown in a titled `<iframe>`.

| Key                                 | Action                    |
| ----------------------------------- | ------------------------- |
| <kbd>Enter</kbd> / <kbd>Space</kbd> | Preview, download, remove |
| <kbd>Escape</kbd>                   | Close the preview         |

## RTL and Dhivehi

Thaana file names are isolated with `<bdi>` so extensions stay in the right place.

<!-- docs/files-and-media/document-download.md -->

# DocumentDownload

A downloadable document card with its type, size and a download link, optionally in several language versions (English and Dhivehi).

```tsx
import { DocumentDownload } from "@javaabu/onu"

<DocumentDownload
  title="Decentralisation Act (Law No. 7/2010)"
  description="Consolidated with amendments up to 2025"
  versions={[
    { lang: "dv", href: "/laws/7-2010-dv.pdf", size: 1_240_000 },
    { lang: "en", href: "/laws/7-2010-en.pdf", size: 980_000 },
  ]}
/>

<DocumentDownload title="Tender form" href="/files/tender.docx" fileName="tender-form.docx" size={56_000} />
```

Language buttons show the language's own name ("ދިވެހި", "English") with `lang` and `hreflang`; pass `label` for other languages.

## Props

| Prop          | Type                                          | Description                                                   |
| ------------- | --------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `title`       | `ReactNode`                                   | Document title                                                |
| `titleText`   | `string`                                      | Plain title for accessible names when `title` is not a string |
| `description` | `ReactNode`                                   | Secondary text                                                |
| `href`        | `string`                                      | Download URL (single version)                                 |
| `fileName`    | `string`                                      | Name to save as                                               |
| `size`        | `number`                                      | Size in bytes                                                 |
| `type`        | `string`                                      | MIME type                                                     |
| `versions`    | `DocumentVersion[]`                           | `{ lang, href, label?, size?, type? }`                        |
| `meta`        | `ReactNode`                                   | Extra details (date, reference number)                        |
| `classNames`  | `{ icon, title, description, meta, actions }` | Classes for each part                                         |

## Accessibility

The card is a group labelled by its title. Links are named "Download {title}" or "Download {title} in {language}", which contains the visible text.

| Key              | Action   |
| ---------------- | -------- |
| <kbd>Enter</kbd> | Download |

## RTL and Dhivehi

Titles are isolated with `<bdi>`; buttons fill the width in narrow containers and size to content in wide ones.
